notes.title: Game Mode Rework
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26303899/f41890740054e5fe2d2d47fbb0c70eda9462cfb1.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

In 2020 we set out to improve and expand Deceit, and we’re now on track to release multiple huge updates over the course of next year. Today we’re excited to be releasing the biggest update in Deceit’s history so far!

For the last few months we've been working on refinements to the Deceit game mode. This has included community beta tests of three different game modes to help inform the best way forward. These changes have focussed primarily on accessibility and supporting our ongoing plans for new items and other content.

We have huge plans for 2021, with new items, terrors, abilities and maps. In order to add all of this new content we needed to make sure that the game can support it, without too steep of a learning curve, and without balancing issues. Today’s update doesn’t yet bring all of that new content, but it does a lot to refine what was already there.

After this big shift to the core experience, we are now in a position to release far more regular game updates. We'll be keeping a close eye on feedback, and we’re hugely excited for the coming months; there’s a lot more to come! For those of you wishing to discuss the game mode amongst each other & with the developers, please [url=https://discord.com/invite/deceit]join our Discord[/url].

Please read the patch notes if you want to know more details, or jump in-game to try it out now. This game mode will be replacing the existing one in all queue types. PS, we’ll leave the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/466240/view/2924489389633481045]Christmas lights up[/url] ‘till January.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26303899/4060076faf8cdf6d629126fb78c75922919dd7e6.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Intro Period[/h3]
[list]
[*] You now begin your journey standing around a table in a dark room.
[*] One player is selected as Infected and is then given a brief period of time to select an Infected partner.
[*] Once this is done both infected players can choose their Terror type.
[*] Whilst this is happening, everyone is able to talk amongst each other. 
[/list]
[h3]Day Period[/h3]
[list]
[*] At the start of each area you’ll spawn scattered around the map.
[*] After a brief period, players are assigned a crate. The first crate assigned is always close to you, subsequent ones will try to be selected across the map from you. 
[*] These crates provide items from that area’s available item spawn table. Currently you can collect Cameras, Torches and Traps in every area. The Tracker is available only in the first two areas, the Shotgun in the last two and the Inspection Kit on the final floor.
[*] Some items are only available in limited quantities. Once all of those items have been taken, the crate will default to giving out Torches.
[*] There is still the two-player objective in each area containing a powerful item, separate to the above spawn table.
[*] Players can complete as many objectives as they'd like each day period.
[*] Fuse Boxes, now repurposed, can be smashed to reduce the length of the day period. Doing this can be advantageous for either team depending on the situation.
[*] Sprinting, shooting or jumping will highlight your position during this period to the Infected.
[*] During this period everyone is able to talk amongst each other. 
[/list]
[h3]Night Period[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upon the night period starting, everyone is transformed into a shadowy ghost figure.
[*] The Infected are able to transform into a Terror at any point during this period.
[*] The Innocents need to collect power from the power points around the map.
[*] Collecting power (along with sprinting, shooting and jumping) will reveal your location to the Infected.
[*] Once you’ve reached 100% power, the game will automatically progress to the next area. In the final area reaching 100% power will reveal the Escape Door.
[*] Only the Infected are able to talk during this period. Once the Escape Door is open on the final floor, everyone can talk again.
[/list]
[h3]Voting Players Out[/h3]
[list]
[*] After downing a player during the Day Period you can opt to initiate a vote against that player.
[*] Initiating a vote will pause the Day Period, taking everyone back to the original table to start the voting process.
[*] Each player has a screen in front of them where they can cast their vote on who they want to be eliminated, or they can skip if they are undecided.
[*] The vote initiator automatically votes against their target, whilst the target automatically skips.
[*] The amount of votes required is based on the number of players in the game, and if that number is satisfied then the receiving player will be eliminated.
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Humans can not damage other humans at night, only Terrors. 
[*] The Camera, Torch & Traps now all also deal damage to Terrors as well as slowing them. 
[*] Traps can now set other traps off, causing a chain reaction.
[*] Terrors respawn on the spot if downed, so make sure to run away if they're attacking you.
[*] If a Terror opts to transform out, they will be downed & respawned elsewhere. 
[*] Players can no longer revive each other. 
[*] Players no longer lose items or blood when they are downed.
[*] Terrors can no longer have their executions cancelled.
[*] Terrors are no longer stopped from executing, transforming out or using vents when affected by Light items.
[/list]
[h3]Infected[/h3]
[list]
[*] Infected now have levels, starting at 1 and going to 5. You level up by collecting blood points.[list][*] Level 1: Swipe unlocked (LMB), letting you swipe players dealing 100 damage 
[*] Level 2: Ability unlocked (RMB) 
[*] Level 3: Execute unlocked (LMB), 150s cooldown 
[*] Level 4: Execute cooldown reduced to 60s 
[*] Level 5: Execute cooldown reduced to 1s 
[/list]
[*] All blood & levels are shared between both Infected. 
[*] There are several ways to gain blood offering varying amounts of points: 
[list][*] Drinking blood bags (worth more each area)
[*] Swiping down players at night
[*] Mauling downed players reduces their respawn time & gives blood (scaling with level) 
[*] Executing a player
[*] Your teammate being eliminated 
[*] Every second after the escape door is revealed
[/list]
[*] Infected will now only get outline visibility to the Innocent if they’re making noise (sprinting, jumping, shooting and in power points).
[*] All of the Terrors have had their health increased.
[*] The Yeti has been made slightly faster by default and had its ability adjusted. The ability no longer self-slows or provides damage immunity but will still cleanse any existing slows & stop new slows from being applied for 2 seconds.
[*] The Vampire & Werewolf have had their speed slightly reduced.
[/list]
[h3]Maps[/h3]
[list]
[*] All the maps have been adjusted to account for the new mechanics above.
[*] The Asylum lighting has been reworked
[list]
[*] Real-time global illumination
[*] Implemented analytical area lights
[*] Art pass on most rooms to improve visual quality
[*] The Asylum middle floor cells mezzanine stairs removed
[*] The Asylum top-floor has a new route that encircles the floor
[/list][/list]
[h3]Win Condition[/h3]
[list]
[*] You now win and lose as a team, even if you died during the game. As long as one Innocent escapes the Innocent win, otherwise the Infected win. 
[*] If you leave before a winner has been determined, that game will count as a loss for you, even if your team goes on to win.
[/list]
[h3]General Adjustments [/h3]
[list]
[*] There is now a set of in-game Tutorial screens that can be viewed in the Main Menu. Players will be required to view these at least once before being able to queue up for a game.
[*] You can now see which character each player is playing as in the loading screen.
[*] We've added channeled interactions to the game. This is used for starting votes against players and destroying Fuse Boxes & Traps.
[*] State is now shown on player nametags (e.g. Interacting, Reviving, Inspecting). 
[*] Players can no longer be antidoted (and as such the item has been removed), an execution that successfully goes through means a player is eliminated from the game. 
[*] You can now sprint & switch weapons at the same time. 
[*] If you have a full inventory, the game will try to replace your currently equipped item when picking up a new one. If you're holding a Pistol or Knife, it'll replace your last item. 
[*] The camera now charges up over a second after you use it, flashing once the charging has finished.
[*] As the night period no longer has a timer it is possible to hit a timeout, if you hit it then the Infected will automatically win.
[*] The rep counter now supports numbers higher than 100,000 on the main menu.
[*] Perks have temporarily been disabled due to balancing concerns. We’ll be addressing this in a future update.
[*] [FIXED] - The Main Menu will occasionally overlap with the Loading Screen when entering a game.
[*] [FIXED] - The Main Menu UI sometimes isn’t visible upon first load.
[/list]

See you in-game,
The Baseline Team

notes.notes:
[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*]Added a [i]Default[/i] option for both input and output voice devices, when set to this, it will use the system default devices for voice input/output.
[*]Adjusted how voice volume is handled to reduce the amount of distortion and peaking.
[*]Upgraded the version of CryEngine we use to the latest public version, allowing us to re-enable some screen effects in-game.
[*]Removed the physics proxy on the Escape Doors in the Asylum & Arctic maps to stop players from getting stuck behind them.
[*]Fixed some map exploits & bugs on the Asylum, Arctic, Forest & Lumberyard maps.
[*]The in-game UI will no longer be faded out if you open the Terror Selection window straight after waking up.
[*]Updated our in-game translations thanks to our Community Translators.
[/list]

[h3]New Cosmetics[/h3]
[i]All of these cosmetics can be obtained either with Credits or via the Loot Booth![/i]
[list][*][Accessory] Monocle & Pipe (Hans)
[*][Hair] Lob (Rachel)
[*][Knife] Iron (All characters)
[*][Knife] Tazer (All characters)
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Update Beta - Coming Soon![/h3]
Throughout the year we've been working on designing, and testing, some fundamental adjustments to the way that Deceit is played. There are plenty of reasons behind why we're wanting to make these changes, but some of the standout ones are:
[list][*][b]Making Deceit a more intuitive game.[/b] [i]Whilst many of the mechanics in Deceit are quite simple to understand once explained, they're not always easy to grasp straight off the bat. A new player should be able to pick Deceit up and have fun without having to study the game first.[/i]
[*][b]Setting Deceit up such that we can easily add more content.[/b] [i]With how Deceit is structured right now it is quite hard for us to add new, exciting, content without it causing a balancing nightmare. We want to be able to quickly iterate on adding new and interesting content to the game, keeping it fresh and replayable for all players.[/i]
[*][b]Increasing the opportunities for deception in-game.[/b] [i]With how it currently stands, Deceit can quite quickly be 'solved' early on in the game. We want Deceit to hold up to its name and truly have deception tactics that can be used throughout the game.[/i]
[/list]

So, where are we at right now? We're currently testing, and iterating, our first set of changes, loosely named the 'Flow' update. These changes are primarily targeting improving a player's first time experience, encouraging more discussion & deception and making voting more intuitive. So far our testing has primarily been purely within the development team, but we have recently started playing with some select members from the community to get their input. In the near future we'll be opening up testing these changes to a wider audience in order to get more feedback on the direction we're taking the game.

Interested in helping test & provide feedback on these changes? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/deceit]Discord server[/url] to be kept in the loop about participating. We anticipate that these tests will start over the next week or two, pending on our internal tests.


See you in-game!
The Baseline Team

notes.title: 2020 Summer Event
notes.notes:
It's Summer time! When you next open the game you'll be greeted with a new interface to help you track your progress throughout the Summer event.

[b]Summer Rewards[/b]
First things first, the loot. This event there's 35 blisteringly hot new rewards to get your hands on, just be careful that you don’t burn yourself. Some of these rewards can be earned through our free Summer Getaway Story, and all of the rewards can be earned directly through the Loot Booth when using Summer Tokens (now available in the store). Grab as many rewards while you can, and if you're lucky enough to get everything there's even a special emblem waiting for you. There are three free Summer tokens waiting for you in game to help you get started.

Here is how the rewards break down for this event, with every character receiving a cosmetic outfit. Go into the Summer Event interface to see them in all their glory:

[b]Common[/b]
3 Emblems & 6 Sprays (New Feature - read on)
[b]Uncommon[/b]
2 Victory Poses
1 Wristband, 1 Pistol, 1 Knife
[b]Rare[/b]
2 Defeat Poses
1 Wristband, 1 Pistol, 1 Knife
2 Clothes, with 2 matching Hats
[b]Legendary[/b]
1 Wristband, 1 Pistol, 1 Knife
4 Clothes, with 4 matching Hats
1 Terror Skin


[b]Summer Getaway Story[/b]
We know you might be stuck inside right now, so we decided to bring the holiday to you. How about a well deserved break away in the Spanish Riviera? This event we’ve got a 25-step Challenge Story which changes based on the decisions you make. And get this, from start to finish it's free-to-play. Go to the Challenge interface in game to get started.

You'll notice as you progress through the story line that there are both free and  Premium Rewards available. Premium Rewards will only be collected if you buy any Loot Booth pack during the event. Don’t worry if you pass premium rewards without having purchased a pack, if you choose to buy one later on you’ll collect all the ones you’ve missed.

[b]Sizzler Bonus & Tickets[/b]
The Summer Sizzler Bonus is a new system that's part of the Loot Booth during the event. Whenever you play the Loot Booth you'll collect points that fill a bar. Once the bar is full you'll receive a Ticket.

Tickets have a rarity and allow you to pick any reward matching their rarity in the Summer Event interface. Simply click on a reward to redeem your ticket.

[b]Cosmetics, Loot Booth & The Vault[/b]
In addition to the Summer Rewards going into the game today there has also been a bunch of new cosmetics added to each character. We've also gone through all of the cosmetics in the game and adjusted some of their rarities and names to make the overall experience of collecting them feel more complete. Head to the Profile to see what's changed.

The Loot Booth has even been updated this release. It now features an improved flow when using tokens and displays your rewards in the 3D scene. We’ve also marked a bunch of cosmetics as Legacy and put them into The Vault. These will still be obtainable as rewards from the Loot Booth but very rarely. We’ve also included event rewards that are over a year old here so you can get them all year round rather than waiting for an event.

[b]New Feature: Sprays[/b]
We’ve added a new cosmetic type to the game, the Spray. These are new graphics that you can collect, with over 40 being released today. Head to the Profile to view them in all their glory and equip them per character. Then, when you’re next in-game press ‘C’ to tag the map with your chosen spray.

[b]Performance & Stability Improvements[/b]
As part of this update we’ve included a first version of some performance improvements we’ll be doing over the next several updates. This week’s update in particular targets users who play on ‘low’ graphics settings, and should enable people on lower end hardware to have a smoother experience.

In addition to this, over the past few weeks we’ve released several hotfixes which has reduced the number of crash reports we received by over 95%. This is something we’ll be continuing to monitor and will aim to reduce this even further.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list][*] Loot Booth Tokens are now available through levelling again, any tokens earned through play during events will be event specific tokens.
[*] The chances of getting cosmetics have been added to the loot booth interface.
[*] You can now unlock emblems and sprays from the Loot Booth.
[*] GM Credits have been renamed to just ‘Credits’.
[*] You can now win Credit packs from the Loot Booth.
[*] You can buy current event rewards with Credits.
[*] Credits have been removed from Token Packs.
[*] The largest Token Pack has changed from 110 Tokens to 125.
[*] The ‘Kongphan hood’ is now only available on Hans.
[*] The ‘Yeti Mask’ is now only available on Chang.
[*] When winning accessory, clothing and head item rewards from the Loot Booth that were previously shared across characters you will now win them individually per character. (Note: existing owners will still have them on all 6 characters).
[*] We’ve added regional pricing for a number of currencies for in-game purchases.
[*] The animation of cup shuffling is now shorter.
[*] You can no longer ‘skip’ the Loot Booth animation.
[*] Chat on the main menu can now be closed by pressing the bar at the top of the chat.
[*] Set your Character Preference to random so each time you’ll play as someone different.
[*] The website links in-game have been updated.
[*] XP boost prices have been adjusted.
[*] The ‘red mic’ bug that occasionally occurs at the start of the game has been fixed.
[*] A bug within the jumping logic has been resolved.
[*] Added a settings option for Anti-Aliasing.
[*] Fixed a bug with the profile incorrectly showing a gold dot next to it despite having seen every cosmetic.
[*] Resolved an issue that caused game updates to be larger than necessary. This fix will apply to future updates.
[*] Removed in-game and menu FPS caps.
[/list]

See you in-game!
The Baseline Team

notes.title: v5.0.0 - Lumberyard Map & Game Engine Upgrade
notes.notes:
[h3]Lumberyard Map[/h3]
After a long time coming, Deceit's most anticipated update ever is here today! And no - you don't need to check your calendar, it isn't April 1st. The Lumberyard is finally here! Our 5th map offers a refreshing space for your group to venture through - a timber filled ravine, with each area you pass feeling and looking different to the last. To celebrate this release, for the next week we've doubled the likelihood of the Lumberyard being selected in both ranked and casual queues. We'd also to give a massive thanks to the Community Mods for their hard work in testing and providing feedback on the map!


[h3]Engine Upgrade - CRYENGINE 5.6[/h3]
Over the past few months we've been working hard on updating the game engine that Deceit runs on. Upgrading from Deceit's previous engine version, CRYENGINE 5.3, brings over 3 years of bug fixes, features and performance improvements worked on by the team at Crytek. Not only does this improve the speed of us being able to integrate future CRYENGINE updates, this also brings a lot of additional upgrades and improvements to our tooling behind the scenes, which allows us to develop content in a much more efficient way, improving our iteration speeds in creating releases like the Lumberyard Map. You can expect significant visual and gameplay improvements to come off of the back of this upgrade in our future updates. Finally we'd like to re-iterate our thanks to those in the community that helped us beta test this release, your help was truly invaluable.


[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*]Parties of 6 are now be able to optionally select a map when queuing up for a game.
[*]The 'Profile' section of the Main Menu has received an uplift. As part of a larger collection of improvements, players will now be able to rotate their characters when viewing them. As well as this, the cosmetic slots for knives, guns and wristbands will now display a rotatable model of the item.
[*]Added a new service for receiving game crashes. This will help us identify what crashes occur, their frequency and enables us to more easily resolve them.
[*]Estonian & Romanian translations have been added to the game. As well as this, several of our other languages have had their translations updated. Many thanks to our community translators for their help.
[*]Players that are unable to connect to games will now receive queue timeouts in order to reduce the frequency of games failing to start.
[/list]


[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*][FIXED] Players are unable to use the Windows 'Copy' function when Deceit is open.
[*][FIXED] The cursor will occasionally draw on top of the game in situations where it shouldn't.
[*][FIXED] Deceit will crash if you leave a game whilst someone is being executed.
[*][FIXED] The crosshair is occasionally hidden when it shouldn't be.
[*][FIXED] The gold dot on the 'Profile' button in the Main Menu shows even if you don't have new cosmetics.
[*][FIXED] Players will occasionally be left unable to move after placing a trap.
[*][FIXED] Traps are incorrectly placed when the placing animation gets cancelled.
[*][FIXED] If you attempt to place a trap when you are unable to you will be unable to place again another for a short cooldown.
[*][FIXED] Terrors are able to use vents on floors that they aren't on.
[*][FIXED] The Vampire Terror is able to use its ability at the end of the night period in to reach the next floor.
[*][FIXED] The player's setting for 'Motion Blur' commonly gets overridden.
 [/list]


[h3]Public Developer API Changes[/h3]
[list][*]A public git repository has been set up for [url=https://github.com/BaselineGG/DeceitAPI]documentation[/url]. Developers can contribute to this through pull requests.
[*]The hiscores endpoint now returns the top 100 instead of just the top 10.
[*]Developers can now send up to 10,000 requests per day, up from 1,000.
[*]Added a [i]perkTree[/i] endpoint. By default this provides information about the current perk tree. Developers can also send an [i]id[/i] parameter to get information about a specific perk tree.
[*]Interested in learning more? Visit [b]#api-discussion[/b] in our [url=https://discord.gg/deceit]Discord[/url]!
[/list]


See you in-game!
The Baseline Team

notes.title: V4.6.0 - Easter 2020
notes.notes:
What’s crackin’? We’re back with an [i]eggcellent[/i] Easter event that’s quite a bit different to past seasonal events. From today through to Thursday 23rd April you’ll be able to earn brand new Easter-themed cosmetics through daily challenges. There are also new exclusive cosmetics available from the Easter Pass, which unlocks our first ever challenge story line! More details below.

We’d also like to take a moment to celebrate hitting 8 million Steam downloads! This is a huge achievement for us and we’re ecstatic that so many people enjoy playing Deceit. Thanks to your support so far this year we’ve been able to increase the number of updates coming to the game, and we’re looking forward to bringing lots more content throughout 2020!

[b]Easter Points[/b]

When opening Deceit you will find the store has been updated, now also containing a selection of our new Easter cosmetics that can be purchased for Easter points. These points can be gained through a variety of methods: collecting eggs that will be spawning throughout the Asylum, Forest, Arctic & Mansion; earning them as rewards from daily challenges; completing special Easter challenges from the Event Pass; through the Event Stash; or through visiting the Loot Booth and using Easter tokens.


[b]Easter Event Pass[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26303899/eae2c35eb562c34d98d890b436eee455c64bba7c.png[/img]

The Easter Event Pass is unlocked by purchasing one of the two Easter Bundles from the Easter Store. In obtaining this pass you’re granted access to:
[list]
[*] A brand new [b]20 challenge story line[/b] where you discover the existence of a mysterious and valuable egg from a shady individual. It’s your job to figure out who it’s rightful owner is and return it to them to earn exclusive rewards including[b] 5 unique unlocks, 15 Easter Loot Booth Tokens, +50k Easter Points, a discount on certain Easter rewards, and +75k experience.[/b] 
[*] The ‘[b]Event Stash[/b]’ - any bonus Easter Points from daily challenges, egg collection, and Easter loot booth tokens accumulate in your Event Stash. The event pass unlocks the stash meaning all points that are already in it and that are added going forward will go straight to your Easter Points to spend.
[/list]

[b]Easter Tokens[/b]

Similar to previous events, Easter tokens will be available to purchase from the store. When using these special tokens at the loot booth you’ll earn both Easter Points and Event Stash Points, as well as provide a chance at unlocking old Easter cosmetics from past events! These include:

[*] ‘Eggcellent!’ Victory Pose

[*] Bunny Terror

All seasonal tokens prior to 2019 have now been converted to regular loot booth tokens, and all unspent Halloween 2019, Christmas 2019, and Easter 2020 tokens will be converted to regular loot booth tokens 1 week after the end of the Easter event. Please also note: all tokens earned through regular challenges will be regular loot booth tokens.

[b]Easter Rewards[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26303899/b70c5b0bfc3a9487d23707ac3ad3aec99b527812.png[/img]

notes.title: v4.5.0 - Challenge System
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We're extremely excited to announce that with patch v4.5.0 comes one of the biggest updates to Deceit that has happened in a long time, and the first of many to come this year. Without further ado, let's get into it...

[h1]Challenge System[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26303899/7e5f15e9c360999542452bcd18be9728e1443b51.png[/img][h3]Overview[/h3]Challenges are composed from a set of tasks that, when completed, allow players to earn a variety of rewards including XP & rare Emblem unlocks. Starting with this update we'll be rolling out daily challenges, with further expansions planned for the near future. Challenges can be viewed, and activated, from the main menu. Once in-game, players can check what challenges they have active by using the 'Q' menu.

[h3]Challenge Slots[/h3]Starting from the moment you first play Deceit, players will unlock slots to place their challenges in. There are a total of 6 slots that one can unlock through levelling up, with the last slot being made available at level 50. In order to progress a challenge you must first activate it, putting it into an empty slot. Players can also opt to deactivate a challenge to free up that slot back up again. Deactivating a challenge will clear any progress made on it and will return it to the set of available challenges.

[h3]Challenge Types[/h3]There are two types of challenges, single and double. Single challenges are the most basic version, simply complete the set of tasks within the challenge to earn the reward. With double challenges there's a little more to it, tasks are split into "Innocent" and "Infected" sections. Tasks in these sections can only be progressed when you're playing as the associated team. Once you've completed the tasks under one team you're able to hand in the challenge to earn that team's rewards. Happen to prefer the other team's rewards? No problem. Completing both sides of the challenge enables you to choose which set of rewards you'd prefer.

[h3]Daily Challenges[/h3]Refreshing every day at midnight UTC, players will receive a collection of 8 challenges ranging from easy difficulty to very hard. These challenges are randomly generated from a set of tasks, combined to reach the required difficulty. 

Provided you meet the required level, dailies can be activated from the main menu. This allows you to progress it and ensures it won't expire. Dailies that aren't activated will automatically expire at midnight, removing them from your list of available challenges. If you deactivate a challenge and it has passed its expiry time it will also be automatically removed.

Each daily has a randomly generated set of rewards with harder challenges offering better rewards. These currently include:[list][*]XP
[*]GM Credits
[*]Loot Booth Tokens
[*]Challenge Chips
[/list]
Along with the above there is also a unique emblem available to be unlocked per each challenge difficulty. The rarity of these emblems are as follows:[list][*]Easy - 1/100
[*]Medium - 1/150
[*]Hard - 1/200
[*]Very Hard - 1/250
[/list]
[h3]Challenge Chips[/h3]Challenge chips allow you to perform a set of actions on your daily challenges. You'll earn one of these per day, at the same time as your daily challenge regeneration, capping at 5. These can also be earned from challenges, earning them this way allows you to temporarily break the cap. Once you've got a challenge chip you can use it from within the main menu's challenge interface in order to:[list][*][b]Share[/b] - All other players in your game will automatically help you progress your challenges for you. You will still get the full reward from the challenge.
[*][b]Boost[/b] - Automatically complete a challenge but only earn 50% of the XP reward and nothing else.
[*][b]Reroll[/b] - Generate a replacement challenge with the exact same difficulty and expiry time.
[*][b]Extend[/b] - Add 24h to the expiry time of the challenge.
[/list]

[h1]Easter Event - Coming Next Week[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26303899/3cf463ca84e19510c1c2ad358fde4fa642d4894b.png[/img]Soon the Easter Bunny will be passing through to do their yearly collection of Easter eggs. Whilst they're here players will be able to acquire an array of new Easter-themed rewards through earning Easter points from finding eggs in-game, challenge rewards & the loot booth.

On top of the above we'll be using the new challenge system to bring those that opt into purchasing an Event Pass a brand new Easter storyline to be played through. As players progress along the story they will earn new, limited time, Easter-themed rewards, as well as extra Easter points to spend.

Those participating can expect to be able to acquire a hopping mad Yeti, Nina after a chocolate eating contest, Chang on the Easter Bunny's shoulders, and so much more. We'll also be putting the previous year's Easter cosmetics into the loot booth for players to obtain again.

Make sure you get online during the 2 week long event to grab what you can!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1][list][*]Challenge stats have been added to the player profiles.
[*]The character you're currently playing as is now shown at the bottom left of the screen.
[*]Further improved our ability to identify, and debug, live server issues.
[*]The Russian, Brazilian & Portuguese languages have been updated. Many thanks to the support from our community translation team for helping with this.
[*]Added a Brazilian queue for matchmaking.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*]Player nametags will no longer overlap with the "Give Rep" screen at the end of the game.
[*]Scanner results on the End of Round screen will now be accurate.
[*]Resolved an issue that caused matchmaking to occasionally completely stop working. As part of this the matchmaking logic has been adjusted, resulting in slightly better matching.
[*]New players will now correctly start at level 1, instead of 0.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 19.03.2020

notes.title: Patch Notes - 12.03.2020
notes.notes:
[h2]Server Infrastructure Improvements[/h2] Over the past few updates, we have been reworking our backend infrastructure in order to support a larger number of players online concurrently. You may have noticed over the past week that during certain periods of the day, you would be stuck on "Game Found" when attempting to queue for a game.  This was normally due to there not being enough dedicated game servers available to deal with the number of games being started, and our infrastructure was not scaling quickly enough to deal with the demand. This update brings a overhaul of the infrastructure providing dedicated game servers, with the aim of improving the reliability and speed of starting games. We will be able to start more games concurrently and have the ability to scale faster than before.


[h2]General[/h2][list][*] Cosmetics introduced in seasonal events will now display the release year & type of event that they came from. This can be seen in your cosmetics tab within your profile.
[*] First time players will be randomly assigned a preferred character instead of being defaulted to Alex.
[*] Added a new detection method to the anticheat and further refined existing methods.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*] FIXED - Players can instantly place a trap down by performing an animation cancel.
[*] FIXED - Redistribution users can pick up exploded traps.
[*] FIXED - Terrors can perform multiple executions without the required amount of blood.
[*] FIXED - Players downed in the gas gain blood from Revitalise when they are automatically revived.
[*] FIXED - Character cosmetic changes in the main menu aren't replicated to other party members.
[*] FIXED - Switching preferred characters in the main menu results in other party members seeing the default cosmetics for your new character.
[*] FIXED - Players in-queue are incorrectly transitioned to 'Game Found' before a server is ready for them to use.
[/list]

notes.title: v4.4.0 - New Perks, Season Reset & Anticheat
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Firstly we'd like to thank everyone that participated in our event to celebrate Deceit's 3rd birthday. A whopping 36,000 players showed up throughout the day with about 15% of you earning the now not-so-secret emblem! For those that didn't quite manage to work out how to collect it, you needed to win 3 games back-to-back. Now, onto the patch notes...

[h1]New Perk Tree & Season Reset[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26303899/ff858283c7695d7115d7447970dbd0071692a43c.png[/img]

This update marks the start of a new in-game season bringing a brand new perk tree to complete and resetting in-game ranks. The new tree contains a set of 5 new perks as well as 2 new emblems to unlock.

[h3]New Innocent Perks[/h3][list][*][b]Solar Powered[/b] - Torches slowly recharge when the lights are on.
[*][b]Speedy Recovery[/b] - Health packs also instantly heal for 25 upon pickup.
[*][b]Spotting[/b] - Trackers can now be placed on blood bags, showing an outline of the blood bag's state. This tracker displays only to you and is destroyed upon taking damage.
[*][b]Redistribution[/b] - You're able to pick your traps back up again.
[/list]
[h3]New Infected Perk[/h3][list][*][b]Revitalised[/b] - Gain half a slice of blood when revived by an innocent player.
[/list]
For the eager amongst you, the next season reset is currently earmarked for the 2nd of April. We'll confirm exactly when a bit closer to the time.

[h1]Anticheat[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26303899/094128ba7d3b35968bbfec7ca3851b9d8c8dfefa.jpg[/img]

We're happy to announce that with patch v4.4.0, we'll be rolling out our first iteration on anticheat. This initial version will highlight any suspicious activity directly as part of our player report viewing tool. Alongside this, activity that we're confident to classify as cheating will result in automatic permanent bans. Dealing with cheaters will be an ongoing task but we anticipate that this will be a good step towards improving our in-game experience.

[h1]General[/h1][list][*] When reporting a player you will no longer see your name as an option.
[*] Restricted the amount of XP available to be earned per-game through lethal injecting players, antidoting players, casting votes or placing traps.
[*] Silhouettes for blood bags now disappear when you're close to them.
[*] The unlit birthday cake emblem now describes how it was obtained.
[*] Made a minor performance improvement to our backend server.
[*] Replaced one of the guaranteed torch spawns in the first zone with a spawn that randomises between a torch and a tracker.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*] FIXED - The ranked progress UI element on the main menu has non-translated text.
[*] FIXED - The server crashes when invalid data is sent to it in a specific way.
[*] FIXED - Games where players earn 0 XP are occasionally not displayed in the match history.
[/list]

[h1]v4.3.6 Patch Notes[/h1][i]After our release last Thursday we rolled out a hotfix to address some bugs. The patch notes for that release are below.[/i]
[list][*] FIXED - The ranked button is greyed out on first load for players who meet all the requirements to play ranked.
[*] FIXED - Viewing characters for offline players doesn't always load their cosmetics.
[*] FIXED - Party members remain hidden after viewing your cosmetics for your characters.
[*] FIXED - After viewing another player's terror skin and then leaving their profile your cosmetics aren't re-loaded.
[/list]

notes.title: Our 3rd Birthday!

The Baseline Games Team

notes.title: Planned Ranked Changes
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

In the last game update we made some changes to the requirements for playing ranked. Firstly, you can now only queue for ranked games as a solo player; improving the integrity of our ranking system, mitigating opportunities for players to team up and unfairly modify the balance of the game.

Secondly, we changed the level requirement from 10 to 12, which doesn't sound like a lot but due to the XP curve it now takes around 50% more time to get to the level requirement for ranked, giving the player time to learn more about game mechanics and prepare themselves better before playing a competitive mode. Thirdly, as a free-to-play game we’ve seen a number of banned players creating new accounts to continue rule-breaking; you now need 3 terrors unlocked to play ranked, which creates a small pay-wall and helps us enforce the rules. Although this isn’t a replacement for our other player moderation systems, we’re happy with the results we’ve seen based on the changes we have made.

So what's next for ranked? After discussion with community, we're now considering the following changes:
[b]Reward Improvements[/b] - we'd like to change the rewards system so that it doesn’t roll ones which you’ve already unlocked, as well as introduce more meaningful benefits that you can use for the season ahead
[b]Seasons Length [/b]- we'll be changing season length from 1 month to 3 months to give players time to climb and show off when they reach the top (this includes the perk tree)
[b]XP Rates[/b] - increase in XP gained in ranked by an additional 10% to reward the effort put in by players, as well as reworking our leaderboards
[b]ELO Formula [/b]- we’ll be reworking the ELO formula to be resolving issues such as making it less punishing to players who get teammates of a different skill level to them
[b]Season Start & End [/b]- new interfaces to show clearly the start and end of seasons, and having the season reset at a fixed time
[b]Leaving Early [/b]- players that quit games before being eliminated will face a wait time before they can requeue

We'll be rolling out these changes over the coming months but in the meantime we'd love to hear your thoughts on them. It’s also worth mentioning that these updates are not set in stone and are subject to change based on testing and feedback. Please leave comments on this post or join the Deceit Discord to discuss with us.

See you in-game!
The Baseline Team

notes.title: Halloween 2019 In-Game Event
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

Buckle up guys, this is one hair-raising update! Today marks the beginning of our Trick or Treat Halloween event!

[b]Halloween Event: Trick or Treat[/b]
We’re releasing a wide variety of unique cosmetic seasonal rewards alongside some spooky map decorations!

[b]How you gain those sweet Halloween rewards:[/b]
Want to unlock exclusive Halloween rewards? All you need to do is keep your eyes open for delicious in game candy. Collect the candy and it’ll turn into Halloween points; earn enough and you’ll unlock some sweet rewards. To make things a little more difficult the smaller candy rewards the most points, so look for the toffee apples and elusive golden gummy bears if you want to unlock everything as fast as possible. Also keep in mind, [b]if you have an XP boost active, you’ll also get double the amount of candy collected in-game![/b]

The types of candy and size classifications are as follows:
2 Points - Big Gummy Bears (Huge)
4 Points - Bowl of Sweets (Large)
6 Points - Chocolate Bars (Medium)
10 Points - Toffee Apples (Small)
20 Points - Golden Gummy Bears (Tiny)


Lastly there will also be special loot booth tokens available during the holiday. Each loot booth reward comes with a number of Halloween points based on its tier, meaning that even common unlocks can help you chase down Halloween legendary items before the end of the holiday.

[b]Additionally, there are some performance based bonuses outlined below:[/b]
When escaping as an innocent player you will receive an additional 50% points on top of whatever you have picked up in the game.
When executing an innocent as an infected player you will receive an additional 25% points per execution on top of whatever you have picked up in the game.


[b]What are the new rewards?[/b]
This year’s event rewards will be visible in the event screen which is available in the top left of the main menu. You can also use this to track your progress towards the next reward and your overall progress throughout the event.

[b]The event rewards and their costs are as follows:[/b]
[b]Candy Pile Emblem[/b] - 50 points
[b]Edible Wristband[/b] - 200 points
[b]Circus Chang[/b] - 500 points
[b]Ominous Rachel Victory Pose[/b] - 1,250 points
[b]Balloon Sword[/b] - 2,250 points
[b]The Fallen Emblem[/b] - 4,250 points
[b]Hit Squad Lisa Outfit [/b]- 6,500 points
[b]Relic Pistol[/b] - Unlocked at 9750 points
[b]Day of the Dead NiNa Outfit[/b] - 14,000 points
[b]Possessed Hans Defeat Pose[/b] - 20,000 points
[b]Blessed Alex Outfit[/b] - 28,000 points
[b]GLAMpire [/b]- 40,000 points
[b]Infected Note Emblem [/b]- 75,000 points

[b]Halloween Tokens[/b]
Halloween Tokens will replace normal tokens for the duration of the event in both level up rewards and through token purchases (they will not replace the tokens awarded from the Werewolf and Vampire Packs).

To spend Halloween Tokens simply go to the loot booth as normal and select a Halloween Token to give to the shady dealer.

[b]Last Year’s Rewards – In the loot booth for a limited time![/b]
In addition to these rewards, previous Halloween seasons’ rewards will be available in the loot booth for the duration of the event when using a Halloween token! This gives you the chance to drastically expand your inventory with a bunch of seasonal cosmetics available for a limited time only, including the highly sought after clown and demon terror skins.

[b]Ranked Changes[/b]
In our last update we mentioned that we’ll soon be looking to rework our ranked system in order to make it more competitive, and rewarding for our top players. We’re excited to implement this in the coming updates, and we’re really thankful for everyone who’s posted feedback on Discord. In the mean-time we’ll be updating the current ranked system with the following changes, please note that these aren’t the rank reworked mentioned, and is a short-term measure to help improve the quality of ranked games.
[list]
[*] The minimum level required to play ranked has been increased from level 10 to 12. This will require all new players to get 50% more XP before they’re able to join the ranked queue.
[*] To join the ranked queue, players are now required to own at least 3 of the 4 terrors.
[*] The ranked queue has been changed so you’re only allowed to queue as a solo player.
[/list]

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] A plethora of map exploits have been patched across the Asylum, Forest and Mansion maps. We’d like to thank the community for their help in identifying these issues, please reach out to us on Discord if there are any others that need resolving.
[*] Players who win against Baseline developers wearing the new developer emblem will be awarded with a Golden Bunny emblem. Emblems acquired from beating Automaton developers will be kept but can’t be attained any more.
[*] The intro splash screen has been updated.
[*] Players will no longer skip all of prestige 9 after completing prestige 8.
[*] Players who have reached the max level and prestige will now be able to gain a token every time they earn 30,000 more experience.
[*] Characters in the Main Menu will no longer restart their idle animations midway through.
[*] You can no longer reach the succeeding floor when using the Vampire Terror ability towards the end of the blackout.
[*] Party invites now last a lot longer before expiring.
[*] Along with map fixes, we’ve partially restricted the ability to jump really high. A more complete fix will come in the future.
[/list]

notes.title: October Update | Halloween 2019 In-game event
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We know it’s been a while since we last spoke, and we have a lot to fill you in on.

As some of you may already be aware, Automaton, the original Deceit studio, closed its doors at the end of July. We are Baseline Games - a new studio with some familiar faces from the original Deceit team. We have acquired the game and are going to be bringing back regular updates. First of all, we want to thank everyone at Automaton for all of their hard work over the years. With this foundation, we are confident that there’s an exciting future in store!

[b]Halloween 2019[/b]

Firstly, we are excited to announce that for 2 weeks starting from [b]Saturday 26th of October[/b], we’ll be bringing back our highly anticipated Halloween ‘trick or treat’ event. Halloween themed items and decorations will be appearing throughout the Asylum, Forest, Arctic and Manor. You can collect candy to obtain all-new exclusive icons and Halloween-themed cosmetics for all playable characters, and purchase limited edition loot booth tokens. Make sure to gather your friends to get your spook on, as these limited items won’t be available for long!

Along with the Halloween event we’ll be providing a number of quality of life updates to the game, including fixes for a number of map exploits, new anti-cheat, improving the requirements for ranked, and giving more power to our community moderators.

[b]Lumberyard Map Status[/b]

We are also aware that is important for us to address the elephant in the room: ‘What is happening with the Lumberyard map?’. Those of us involved in the update last Halloween made a mistake: we bit off more than we could chew by trying to build a new map from scratch with the very limited time we had available. We still intend to release this and other new map updates, but the Lumberyard is not currently to the quality we deem acceptable for such an important update. However, we now have some resources available for Deceit development, and we’re up for the challenge, so we look forward to bringing it to you soon!

[b]New Ranked Season[/b]

The new ranked season starts [b]tomorrow[/b], Monday 7th October at 21:00 GMT. We’re planning on introducing some changes to ranked in the near future, to improve the way it works and the end of season rewards on offer. The exact changes aren’t confirmed yet, but we’ll be discussing them with you on Discord over the next few weeks.

[b]Future Updates[/b]

Looking beyond Halloween, you can expect the return of regular updates to Deceit. We plan on applying all of the knowledge we have learned over the past 2 years working on other projects into Deceit, and we are confident you’ll see the fruits of our labour very soon. Expect stability improvements, optimisations (over 2 years worth of engine patches coming soon!), advanced anti-cheat detection, and an array of new content.

At the end of the Halloween event we’ll be posting an announcement about our plans for the rest of 2019. In the meantime, we’d love to hear your thoughts on Discord. We know that Deceit has a lot of untapped potential, and we look forward to playing with you all.

See you in-game!
The Baseline Team

notes.title: April Update | New Map
notes.notes:
Dear all, 

We've been working hard on the new map update, however, this is taking longer than previously expected. We are looking to release this as soon as possible and will share more information with you when we can.

Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: March Update
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Following on from our announcement in January, we wanted to give you an update to what’s happening with Deceit. 

Firstly, we’re going to be releasing an update shortly which will provide further server-stability & countermeasures in the case of direct, intentional attacks by malicious members of the community. As a reminder to all members of the community, we take any threat to Deceit or the enjoyment of our players seriously, and anyone found to be violating our community rules of conduct will be punished including possibly being permanently banned from the game.

We’re also looking to release the map to you by the end of April. We’ll look to share photos of the new area before we share this with you in the community.

As we announced back in January, the studio’s focus is on other projects, primarily [url=http://mavericks.gg]Mavericks: Proving Grounds[/url]. We have plans to bring a number of the new technical capabilities we are developing for Mavericks back into Deceit. We don’t expect these new features to make their way over until next year, as we focus the studio on other projects.

We can’t wait to show you the new map and let us know what you think in the comments or on Discord.

notes.title: January Update – Map Update and 2019
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We hope you all had a good Christmas and New Year and are enjoying Deceit now that Halloween has finally finished. We wanted to provide you with an update with what’s going on in the studio at the moment and what’s coming up in the short- and longer-term for Deceit. 

In the short term, the studio’s priorities are primarily focussed on other projects, primarily [url=http://mavericks.gg]Mavericks: Proving Grounds[/url]. This won’t come as a surprise to many of you. Because of this, the game is not going to be heavily developed from a technical standpoint for the next 6+ months – this means no major updates, no substantial new changes.

However, you were promised a new map and we are working on this presently. 

Many in the studio still want to help Deceit grow and develop and so, on their own time, teams are helping finalise the new map before we share it with you all. Exact timelines are unknown currently, but we expect to share this before the end of March.

This doesn’t mean Deceit is dead, far from it. With the new platform and technology going into Mavericks, the studio’s plan is to bring over some of these new capabilities into Deceit. This will however take time and we expect for these substantial changes to be incorporated towards the end of 2019.

So, with so little happening technically, and future plans a long way off, what are we doing in the interim? We plan on doing a number of community-focused activities and events including in-game tournaments, competitions (e.g. Fan Art, Cosplay), amongst some other initiatives which we’ll be sharing more information about in the coming weeks.

Let us know what you think about what’s coming up on our Discord, we’d appreciate the feedback and comments you have.

notes.title: The End of Halloween and Double XP Weekend Event
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We’ve left you in the dark without any updates or communications about what’s happening with Deceit. So first thing, we’re sorry.

We’ve been putting a lot of resource into Mavericks: Proving Grounds and this has left our team thin-on-the-ground, to say the least. Not an excuse, just a reason. You have bought into a game and we should have kept you all informed.

So what’s coming up for Deceit? Immediately, many of you will be happy to know that Halloween has finally finished. Whilst we aren’t going to be running any Christmas events, we are going to be holding a Double-XP weekend event this weekend from 00:00 GMT 22/12/18 till 23:59 GMT 23/12/18.

Staff will be taking some time off over the holiday period for some well-deserved rest, and we are looking to bring further updates to Deceit in the New Year. 

We’re still in the process of developing the Lumberyard map and would like to grant assurances that it will be coming in the new year.

[list][*]2 Points - Big Gummy Bears (Huge)
[*]4 Points - Bowl of Sweets (Large)

[list][*]When escaping as an innocent player you will receive an additional 50% points on top of whatever you have picked up in the game.

[*][b]Hatchet Melee Weapon[/b] - Unlocked at 500 points

[*][b]Alex’s Pumpkin Suit[/b] - Unlocked at 3400 points
[*][b]Cat Emblem[/b] - Unlocked at 5000 points
[*][b]Get Lit Victory Pose[/b] - Unlocked at 7500 points
[*][b]Hans’ Skeleton Costume[/b] - Unlocked at 10000 points
[*][b]Zombie Foot Melee Weapon[/b] - Unlocked at 17500 points
[*][b]Demonic Rachel[/b] - Unlocked at 25000 points
[*][b]Disguise Masks[/b] - Unlocked at 35000 points
[*][b]Ghostly Emblem[/b] - Unlocked at 100000 points[/olist]

[h1]Vampire DLC Pack[/h1]

With the Vampire Expansion, you will be able to prey on innocent victims as you transform into the exclusive Vampire Terror form! This terror form offers a brand new terror tactic through its active: the Swarm.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/c4573e75cc70d3c0b729c74fc641bf095f400af4.jpg[/img]

When used, the Vampire temporarily shape-shifts into a swarm of bats to traverse the vent system at hellish speed leaving a puff of smoke in your wake. Sink your fangs into this pack now by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/968390/Deceit__Vampire_Pack] clicking here[/url].

[b]Wakizashi![/b]
Linked to this we’ve added a special something for those people who unlock both the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/968390/Deceit__Vampire_Pack] Vampire[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/672840/Deceit__Werewolf_Pack/] Werewolf[/url] packs. [list][*]Slight nerf to the Yeti Terror attributes and ability
[*]You can no longer take bloodbags, items and objectives on floors that haven't been unlocked yet

[list][*]New loading screen imagery for all maps
[*]The transform keybind now shows in the Terror icon at the bottom of the game screen

[*]The end of round rank and level up now waits for you to give reputation before animating, meaning you will see your progression in these systems

[list][*]Addressed collision proxies that permitted unwanted access to objects and areas of the map
[*]Added objects to reduce overpowered lines of sight in Forest

notes.title: Dev Blog - Manor Map
notes.notes:
As most of you are aware, over the past few months we’ve been working on a new Deceit map! So far hints have been dropped on the map's theme or contents, and with lots of speculation from the players, we decided it was about time to post a dev blog to keep you all updated on its progress. Along with this short blog about the map's design, there are also a few sneak preview screenshots of what you can expect.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/abab567867c697874ecc10fbc542d48a595475ab.jpg[/img]

As you may have guessed… the theme for this map is “The Manor”. In this new map players will find themselves in a mysterious manor house, but the manor appears to be recently abandoned with the residents nowhere to be found. Who owns the manor? Where have they gone? Can you escape?

The manor follows the same theme as the other Deceit maps: progress through 3 levels, collecting fuses and items along the way, with the goal of escaping… or not. However this map has a twist… unlike the other maps, players will find themselves awakening on the top floor of the manor, and as the game progresses they must make their way downstairs and eventually into the manor's garden.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/303b9bce8bfada438c9d6b71a47a92c588ea21f5.jpg[/img]

The idea behind the map originated from the Asylum, with the original idea being a reversed layout, where players progress downwards from the top floor down to the bottom floor in order to escape. However this posed some problems: currently the maps are structured to become smaller as the games progress to reflect dwindling player numbers as the innocents are eliminated, meaning that a reverse flow would need tweaks to re-balance the scale and sizing of the rooms to follow this design. Taking this into account, we abandoned this idea in favour of creating a brand new map using the Asylum’s assets, such as a mansion or manor. Whilst this would have sped up the process quite drastically, it didn’t have the same effect, and we wanted to give the players something fun and entirely new to add greater variation to our maps.

When designing the map, we had to take into consideration feedback from existing maps to ensure that this map is balanced for both infected and innocent play, taking note of each of the other maps downfalls and advantages. For example, a lot of players find the arctic map too open, which can make gameplay very difficult for the infected, compared to the Asylum, with its huge rooms and long corridors where it is very easy to slip undetected. This information very heavily influenced the design of the map, and we opted for large open doors and archways to allow players to quickly scope out rooms and also provide a more smooth game flow whilst also allowing many blind spots and escape routes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/7cbaf1a7db5f126b69877a4ec1a43f2b7e5049e8.jpg[/img]

This map also is very unique, as it is the first map where one of the levels is entirely different to the others. In the final area players find themselves in a large walled garden, meaning that they have to adapt their playstyle to their new surroundings. Innocent players must work as a team to navigate through a large hedge maze to find the exit. In a place where everything looks very similar, players can easily find themselves lost if they forget to pay attention to their surroundings…

While we do not have an exact launch date, we plan to be releasing even more sneak previews of the map over the coming weeks, and we aim to be able to give you a clearer idea of when you can expect to play in the manor!

notes.title: Community Update - Deceit in 2018!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/458a5579d3899fd46a443d49cda11c478d09c12c.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

After compiling feedback from hundreds of threads, discord messages and the questions prompted by teasing this post, it’s finally time to give everyone an update on what we’ve been working on and share some of our plans for Deceit in 2018!

[h1]Server upgrade – Migration to Google Cloud Platform (Coming soon)[/h1]
It’s an open secret that the consistent growth of new players has been an exciting challenge to keep up with, in fact with over 1,600,000 players active on Deceit and 400,000 new players this month our tech team have been working around the clock to keep as many of you immersed in the game as possible. To give Deceit a longer lasting, stable and scalable solution we’re switching things over to Google Cloud, aiming to give better and more consistent access to the game for everyone! We’ve made this a major priority and we’re expecting to finish this up sometime over the next few weeks.

[h1]Community Administration – Enhancing our community tools (Coming soon)[/h1]
Partially motivated by the huge influx of players from around the globe, we’re revisiting our community administration efforts. Over December we rolled out an early revision of our in house anti-cheat, taking the fight to players who unfairly use tools to gain an advantage over others. Now we’re doubling down on our commitment to creating a great gameplay environment by adding more depth to our internal moderation tools, making your reports matter even more than before and helping us to work through them quickly and accurately. Finally, we’re rounding out the external game experience by expanding our hugely successful community moderation program on Discord. Keep an eye out for some new blue tags and be sure to extend them the same warm welcome you’ve always done as the helpful and passionate players they’ve always been.

[h1]Expanding the world – Building a new map for Deceit (Near future, a few months out)[/h1]
As outlined in a previous post, we are working towards releasing a fourth map for Deceit; currently in extremely early concept stages we wanted to share our commitment to one of the most commonly requested content additions. 

Over the last few weeks our designers have looked at previous locations exploring themes, gameplay and reviewing a swathe of user feedback to shape our next setting into one worth waiting for. More details to follow separately when they are available.

[h1]Growing new communities – Deceit on consoles (Far future, late 2018)[/h1]
Another huge and exciting goal on our roadmap for Deceit this year is bringing it to an even bigger player base through a multi-platform console release. Many potential players have watched Deceit’s development closely, reaching out to us to request a port of the game on Playstation 4 and XBOX One both of which we are happy to confirm are under investigation for later in the year. We look forward to sharing more details on this when development begins.

[h1]Compiled feedback – Top community questions[/h1]
[quote]Are you still fixing bugs or is the game ‘finished’?[/quote]
I think it’s fair to say the game is better than ever before, despite that our team is still working through fixing bugs in order of priority and with respect to their frequency. 

[quote]Will we see more Deceit events in the future?[/quote]
Yeah, we enjoy making them and the community seems very positive about playing them so it’s on our radar.

[quote]I can’t connect to my profile and sometimes games end early, what’s up with that?[/quote]
It’s a server thing and the Google Cloud Platform upgrade should take care of this, in addition to that the server change over should also address issues around users unable to start matches, users experiencing higher than normal latency during peak times and users unable to load their profile.

[quote]Are you going to stop people being able to talk at the beginning of the game before we can see who it is and mute them?[/quote]
Our technical team are already working on this, I’ve personally reviewed a bunch of reports without any accompanying information and the occasional screaming has been a rather unwelcome surprise. Expect something on this in a patch note relatively soon.

[quote]Will my country get a shirt and gun like the others?[/quote]
It’s possible, but we also don’t want to diminish the meaning behind the other cosmetics. Traditionally we’ve added shirts and guns to celebrate the efforts put in by community translators to localise the game, help us understand foreign language communities and assist in promoting Deceit to them.

[h1]Stay up to date![/h1]
Got a great question? Want to contribute the next great Deceit meme? Looking for the insider scoop before the next community update? Be sure to stay in touch by following us on [url=https://twitter.com/PlayDeceit]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayDeceit/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/PlayDeceit/]Twitch TV[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCntMbJtn5QW92DQmpbCUtow/]YouTube[/url] for all of the latest news and trailers.

[b]Sam Hills[/b]
Community Manager

[b]Features:[/b]
[list][*]Terror Updates:
    [list][*]3 unique terrors each with their own abilities.
    [*]Experiment - Creates a decoy that runs forwards for 5 seconds and releases a smoke cloud after 5 seconds or it takes damage.
    [*]Yeti - Becomes invincible to all damage for 1.5 seconds. 
    [*]Werewolf - Howls which disorientates players in human form causing a blurred screen and camera shake.
    [*]Each terror has different speed and health stats.
    [*]Players can select a terror when a match starts. They have 15 seconds from the point they know they are infected to select a terror. The default key for this is T.
    [*]The Werewolf terror is only available to players who have purchased the Werewolf DLC.
    [*]Introduced cosmetic variants for Yeti and Werewolf terrors. Five different skins have been added for each of them.[/list]
[*]Christmas event:
    [list][*]Christmas Event: Naughty or Nice?
    [*]At the end of each game you will be awarded Naughty or Nice points based on your XP gained.
    [*]Infected players in that game will get Naughty points, Innocent players will get Nice points.
    [*]With these points you will unlock seasonal cosmetic rewards which you can access from the event interface in the top-left of the main menu.
    [*]As XP Boosts offer 50% additional XP this will also work in giving you extra Naughty or Nice points.
    [*]During this period we will also be offering Christmas Tokens for the Loot Booth.
    [*]Each Christmas Token will give a chunk of Naughty and Nice points based on the reward rarity that you receive, and will also offer a chance at unlocking previous Christmas rewards.

    [*]Fixed players receiving incorrect borders on season start.
    [*]Removed a Halloween head on a spike from the arctic map.
    [*]Moved a door that would block players from going up a staircase in the Asylum.
    [*]Moved a bookcase that was blocking a vent in the Asylum.
    [*]Fixed an issue which caused the terror claw animation to display incorrectly.[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[list][*]The UI element which shows a player is searching for a game is now shrink on smaller screens.
    [*]Highscores in the profile have now been merged into one tab.
    [*]Various parts of the profile have been visually updated.[/list]

notes.title: Terror Updates
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/cd75075750f13fc420e021cc1ed5dacf3c653bd4.png[/img]

Hey Everyone,

This Friday the 15th we are not only releasing our Christmas event we are also doing some big changes to the core gameplay.

It’s no secret that behind the scenes we’re always working on things we think will make Deceit even more fun. Today we’re sharing our current plan for revamping the way Terror’s work – feel free to share your feedback below.
In a series of previous updates we expanded the arsenal of the innocent players with a significantly improved inventory system allowing them to utilise more items quickly and effectively. Following that we added new items and changed the usage of old ones to cultivate different play styles, this ultimately gave rise to our light and darkness update that has shaped Deceit into the game it is today. Now we’re transforming the game again as we follow a similar path for the Terror.

Instead of one terror form we’ll be making a variety of unique monsters, each with their own visual style, special abilities and stats. Our aim is to launch this with the classic terror (Experiment), a fully fleshed out Yeti and the DLC Werewolf. Overall despite their unique nature our aim is to provide more content for users who have not paid for additional DLC and tune any paid content to be different and not stronger. It’s important to us that no user feel they are required to play a specific monster and instead plays around with what they feel they enjoy and works best for them, pride and accomplishment is from playing the game not paying the game.


Disclaimers aside, here are the changes to the terrors:

Each of the terrors has its own unique active ability and each of them have different health and speed stats makes them all their own gameplay experience. These abilities are available as soon as a player transforms into terror form and once used they have a cool down before they can be used again.

[b]Experiment (Classic Terror)[/b]
The Experiment is our all-rounder a good balance of speed and survivability. Its active ability is one designed with utility in mind that will help when trying to engage innocents or escape from them.

Active: Decoy – A clone of the Experiment rips out it and runs straight forward for 5 seconds. If the clone is damaged or its 5 second life span is reached the decoy is destroyed and it produces a thick cloud of smoke to obscure other players view.

[b]Yeti[/b]
The Yeti is the tank terror, he is slower than the others but can take more punishment. Its active doubles down on this.

Active: Frozen Fury – The Yeti creates frosty armour and becomes invulnerable to both physical and light damage but it will also reduce his speed for a for a few seconds.

[b]Werewolf[/b]
The Werewolf is our assassin terror, very fast but also fragile so engagements with the innocent must be carefully considered. But its Active helps balance the fragility a little by disorientating innocents.

Active: Outcry – The Werewolf unleashes and blood curdling howl that causes all human characters within its radius to become confused and their vision is blurred for a few seconds.

[b]Terror select[/b]
Terrors are selected at the start of a game, upon waking up infected players will have 15 seconds to choose a terror from the new terror menu accessed by pressing the Transform key.

And finally, each of the two new terror types have their own unique skins each fitting within the themes, the Ape like Yeti and the Canine Werewolf.

Also if you had already unlocked the Yeti skin we are giving you a couple of items to replace it, a unique yeti terror emblem and its value in GM credits.

notes.title: Winter Event begins December 15th!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/93945c9373ba9f2420d322c39a24d090d1789325.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

On Friday 15th December, the Deceit Winter event begins! The event will last three weeks and give you all a chance to earn a unique set of new rewards and a selection of items from last year. We’re calling this event ‘Naughty and Nice’ and there’ll be two separate paths of unlocks for you to earn following the theme – Naughty for the infected and Nice for the innocents!

Hold on for hats, jump in for jumpers and come claim some coal –  For this event, all you need to do is play! As you earn experience you’ll also be given special points based on whether you’re naughty (infected) or nice (innocent) which will take players down two unique paths of unlocks new to Deceit. 

Similarly to our last event, there will be special loot booth tokens available during the festivities which will unlock a selection of rewards from last year’s Winter event, including the coveted Turkey Head and give users points towards this year’s unlocks.

notes.title: Winter Event begins December 15th!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/93945c9373ba9f2420d322c39a24d090d1789325.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

On Friday 15th December, the Deceit Winter event begins! The event will last three weeks and give you all a chance to earn a unique set of new rewards and a selection of items from last year. We’re calling this event ‘Naughty and Nice’ and there’ll be two separate paths of unlocks for you to earn following the theme – Naughty for the infected and Nice for the innocents!

Hold on for hats, jump in for jumpers and come claim some coal –  For this event, all you need to do is play! As you earn experience you’ll also be given special points based on whether you’re naughty (infected) or nice (innocent) which will take players down two unique paths of unlocks new to Deceit. 

Similarly to our last event, there will be special loot booth tokens available during the festivities which will unlock a selection of rewards from last year’s Winter event, including the coveted Turkey Head and give users points towards this year’s unlocks.

notes.notes:

[list][*]A history of the items that have been unlocked has been added to the bottom of the loot booth.

notes.title: Community Update – Remains of Halloween, patch preview & future plans
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/aeadeeac8f7acdfeb1f6e23c195a3061ceb91a5c.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

As the Halloween event draws to a close and the candy coloured dust settles, I wanted to let you in on what we’ve been up to, some of the changes for Monday’s end of event patch, and share some vague details of what we’re working on over the next few months.

Firstly, as many users will know, over the last couple of weeks our technical team have released a number of server side updates addressing user volume and server stability. As of the last round of changes, we’re confident that we’ve covered the former and are keeping a close eye on the later. In the wake of over a quarter of a million new users it’s been an interesting challenge but most importantly it’s exciting to welcome all the new members of the community and interact with each of you as you get to grips with Deceit. I’m expecting to put out a post going into more depth on this topic relatively soon.

[h1](Pre)Monday Motivation[/h1]
[b]On Monday, we’ll be ending the Halloween event[/b] meaning all Halloween tokens will be converted into normal tokens, candy will be removed from the map and Halloween points can no longer be earned making all rewards final. For players close to their next reward we’ve made things a little easier; we’re providing double experience gains for the remainder of the event meaning over the weekend you’ll be able to earn and spend more tokens generating significantly more Halloween points for your last chance at this year’s rewards.

Alongside the close of the event we’re fixing some high priority issues, adding a few hotly requested features and making some less than subtle balance tweaks which should up the ante once more. As with every patch we’ll post the full patch notes on the day but I’d like to share some highlights which I know will resonate with many members of the community. 

[list][*]The game now opens in 720p windowed mode for new users
[*]Added chat to the End Game Summary screen
[*]Fixed a bug where you could use the inspection kit multiple times
[*]You can no longer use text/voice chat when bleeding out
[*]Relocated some blood bags in the forest and arctic map[/list]

[h1]Fishing for feedback[/h1]
This patch has been largely shaped by user feedback so it’s important to us that you keep it coming. We read every topic, discord message, direct message, tweet, visitor post and review and it’s important to us to have so many users involved, making sure we can shuffle around our priorities to work on things that matter to you most.

With so many users around the globe I’d like to extend a special shout out to the admins of various community pages who’ve helped us with hearing voices from different regions such as KaizerZ from the Thai community and Lui from the Chinese community. Without the help of so many altruistic individuals and our community translators our work would be significantly more difficult.

[h1]Patch to the future[/h1]
In addition to continuing to squash bugs and tweak gameplay, we’re focussing on some larger points of interest for the game over the next few months which we’d like to share. [b]It’s important to remember that none of this has a specific date and it is currently mostly conceptual. Please do not flood us with requests for further details as we will provide them when they are available to provide.[/b]

[list][*]Among our top priorities right now is anti-cheat integration, we’re testing a few different solutions internally and looking at the best ways to punish users such as integration of Valve Anti-Cheat (VAC). 
[*]Our environment team have been discussing and drawing up the initial conceptual stages of a new map, a key part of this is reviewing how the gameplay in the three existing maps works and what users find to be the most fun and engaging. This entire process is likely to take a few months at the least but we’ll share some more information on this when it’s available.
[*]We’ve received a huge amount of positive feedback around the Halloween event so we’re discussing how to make an even better Christmas/Winter event and give all of our fans something to look forward to over the holiday season.[/list]

[h1]Stay up to date![/h1]
Can’t wait to see the latest video content previews? Waiting for the next Developer stream? Want to share your favourite Deceit moments with us and the rest of our fans? – Stay up to date by following us on [url=https://twitter.com/PlayDeceit]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayDeceit/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/PlayDeceit/]Twitch TV[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCntMbJtn5QW92DQmpbCUtow/]YouTube[/url] for all of the latest news.

[b]Sam Hills[/b]
Community Manager
