notes.title: Halloween Event Overview
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/a156c5866e19fca901bde7490a8b4531e9f50da8.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

Today marks the beginning of the Deceit Halloween Event and the new ranked season, the event will last from after the patch until Monday 13th November and this ranked season will end in approximately one month. This gives everyone just over two weeks to work towards the seasonal rewards before the end of the event.

[h1]How does the event work?[/h1]

This year’s rewards are all shown in a chart which will be in game after the patch, progression along the chart unlocks the corresponding rewards. To progress along the chart players must gather Halloween points which are available through collecting candy whilst playing and using Halloween loot booth tokens which are available in place of normal tokens for the duration of the event.

In addition to all of that, by using Halloween loot booth tokens players can unlock gear from last year’s event meaning there are multiple ways to expand your inventory with unique seasonal cosmetics which are not typically available.

[h1]Halloween points:[/h1]

Halloween points are available by picking up candy in game or through spending Halloween tokens, the smaller the candy or the rarer the item looted the larger the rewards.

The types of candy and size classifications are as follows:

[list][*]Big Gummy Bears (Huge)
[*]Bowl of Sweets (Large)
[*]Chocolate Bars (Medium)
[*]Toffee Apples (Small)
[*]Golden Gummy Bears (Tiny)[/list]

[b]Additionally, there are some performance based bonuses outlined below:[/b]

When escaping as an innocent player you will receive an addition 50% on top of whatever you have picked up in the game.
When executing an innocent as an infected player you will receive an additional 25% (per execution) on top of whatever you have picked up in the game.

[h1]Halloween Tokens:[/h1]

Halloween Tokens will replace normal tokens for the duration of the event in both level up rewards and through token purchases (they will not replace the tokens awarded from the Werewolf Pack).

To spend Halloween Tokens simply go to the loot booth as normal and select a Halloween Token to give to the shady dealer.

[h1]This year’s event rewards:[/h1]

This year’s event rewards will be visible in the event screen which is available in the top left of the main menu. You can also use this to track your progress towards the next reward and your overall progress throughout the event.

The event rewards and rarity are as follows:

[list][*]Halloween Emblem (Common)
[*]Halloween Wristband (Common)
[*]Candy Bucket Hat (Alex)	(Uncommon)
[*]My Candy! Victory Pose (Hans) (Uncommon)
[*]Better Halloween Emblem (Uncommon)
[*]Bride of Frankenstein Hair (Lisa)	(Rare)
[*]Kitty Nina Outfit & Face paint (Nina) (Rare)
[*]Halloween Pistol (Rare)
[*]Too Greedy Defeat Pose (Rachel) (Legendary)
[*]Zombie Chang Outfit (Chang) (Legendary)
[*]Zombie Hand Melee Weapon (Legendary)
[*]Demon Terror (Legendary)
[*]Epic Emblem (Legendary)[/list]

[h1]Last year’s rewards – In the loot booth for a limited time![/h1]

In addition to the event rewards, last year’s Halloween rewards will be available in the loot booth for the duration of the event when using a Halloween token!

Last year’s rewards are as follows:

[list][*]Green Wild Hair (Alex)
[*]Purple Mohawk Hair (Chang)
[*]Pumpkin Mask (Alex)
[*]Hockey Mask (Chang)
[*]Pumpkin Scrubs (Alex)
[*]Prison Scrubs (Chang)
[*]Bone Wristband
[*]Pumpkin Wristband
[*]Sweets Wristband
[*]Bone Gun
[*]Pumpkin Gun
[*]Sweets Gun
[*]Bone Knife
[*]Pumpkin Knife
[*]Sweets Knife[/list]

We hope you all enjoy the event and for anyone looking for additional previews we’ll be posting pictures of the rewards on Twitter and Facebook throughout the season as we track everyone’s progress. We’re also expecting another community update post regarding server status shortly as our technical team have been hard at work ironing out the problems affecting stability.

Sam Hills
[b]Community Manager[/b]

notes.title: v4.0.2 - Patch Notes: Halloween!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/12d472344841d2356b47eb8238a4cb98d716db2b.jpg[/img]

[b]Features[/b]
[list][*]Halloween event, Candy is scattered around the maps collecting this rewards Halloween points. Halloween points unlock Halloween themed cosmetic items. You can check your progress on the new Halloween event interface screen.
[*]Halloween loot booth token, during the Halloween event there is a new loot booth token that will when used in the loot booth gives a chance for getting the 2016 Halloween rewards. They also give some Halloween points based on the rarity of the items you get from the cup that go towards progression in the event. These tokens can only be earned during the event period and any tokens you had before the event will remain but are not converted to Halloween tokens.
[*]2017 Halloween cosmetics, these are unlocked through participation in the event collecting Halloween points. 
[list][*]Midnight emblem
[*]Terror flesh Wristband
[*]Candy Bucket Head (Alex)
[*]"My Candy" Victory Pose (Hans)
[*]Candy Emblem
[*]The Bride Hair (Lisa)
[*]Kitty Outfit & Ears (Nina)
[*]Terror Flesh Pistol
[*]"To Greedy" Defeat Pose (Rachel)
[*]Zombie Outfit (Chang)
[*]Zombie Hand Melee Weapon
[*]Demon Terror Skin[/list]
[*]The voice indicators now show whether or not the player is using the terror voice chat.
[*]When first viewing cosmetics on your profile the default selected character will be your preferred character
[*]New Flag themed cosmetics, there are new a pistol and T shirt themed after the Thailand, Turkish, French and Hungarian flags.
[*]Werewolf execution animation, the Werewolf terror new has unique and exclusive execution animations if you already own the DLC the terror will have the execution.
[*]Added Halloween theme to the Maps.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the torch remaining on when being executed
[*]When voting out the final player the game will now wait for the electrocution to finish before ending.
[*]Fixed voted out players being able to use voice chat.
[*]Fixed voted out players being marked as dodgers if they leave the game early
[*]Fixed a potential issue which caused users to remain stuck on the loading screen after the beginning of a game.
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[list][*]Added emblems for seasons 6, 7 & 8
[*]The Fuse Boxes are now outlined gold
[*]When first viewing cosmetics on your profile the default selected character will be your preferred character
[/list]


---

[b]3rd November - Same version update[/b]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Voice chat now shows which character you are
[*]Your reputation is now shown under your name in the main menu
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Some further fixes to allow servers to support more players.
[*]Fixed some keybindings not properly updating in game
[*]Fixed an issue where tokens bought through the shop wouldn't be received
[*]Fixed a bug where your last unlock received wouldn't be given to you
[*]Fixed a bug where you wouldn't receive certain halloween unlocks (you will need to earn at least 1 point for it to take effect)
[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*]Server select is ordered based on the current amount of players in that region.
[*]Your current language is always shown at the top of your server select.
[*]Added a notification for when you buy products from the shop
[/list]

notes.title: The Deceit Halloween event begins this Friday!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/29f7790fcaed9e8ef6cb4636441c73f373df2642.jpg[/img]

On Friday 27th October, the Deceit Halloween event begins! We’re releasing a wide variety of unique cosmetic seasonal rewards alongside some spooky map decorations and another chance to play with the development team so make sure you’re online!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/e4205d7281ef999a20e1b66a26dc636e4d2da1ab.jpg[/img]
[i]Collect Halloween Candy to gain Halloween points and unlock rewards. Smaller items give more points.[/i]


Want to participate? All you need to do is play Deceit and keep your eyes open for delicious in game candy. Collect the candy and it’ll turn into Halloween points, earn enough and you’ll unlock some sweet rewards. To make things a little more difficult the smaller candy rewards the most points so look for the toffee apples and elusive golden gummy bears if you want to unlock everything as fast as possible.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/efddf87455fe8f4fd6b974699537872b0f6bda0c.jpg[/img]
[i]Kitty Nina outfit and facepaint - Part of the exclusive seasonal rewards.[/i]

Lastly there will also be special loot booth tokens during the holiday and the loot booth will include rewards from last year’s Halloween event. In addition to the chance to earn some of last year’s swag, each loot booth reward comes with extra Halloween points based on the tier of the reward meaning that even common unlocks can help you chase down Halloween legendary items before the end of the holiday.

notes.title: v4.0.1 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/cf380c2c596f816d4c5f4d4d69f3bf400efd3456.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Vote interface now no longer incorrectly says "Vote failed" before voting has ended.
[*]If an execution is cancelled the audio now also cancels.
[*]Players can now no longer vote out executed players. This resolves an issue where players would receive a message telling them they had died twice.
[*]Unequipped cosmetics in the profile are now cleared when changing slot.
[*]All escape doors now correctly show a bright white light behind them.
[*]Asylum start of round screen camera is now in the correct position.
[*]Fixed an issue where cosmetics could not be purchased if the player had the exact currency required.
[*]Fun Sponge now no longer works on levers for completed objectives.
[*]Players should now correctly be able to view the profiles of users which are not on their friends list by navigating to them through other methods such as via the highscores screen.
[*]Sending a message with a comma in the main menu now no longer deletes the message.
[*]The shotgun no longer incorrectly triggers a reload animation when picking up ammo for the Pistol.
[*]Missing Chinese characters have been added to the client and should now display correctly.
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[list][*]Developers have now been given a special icon to verify their authenticity. When a developer is using this icon winning players will be given a special emblem to keep.
[*]Increased the server capacity by tenfold.
[*]Innocent players can now see players who have been voted out on the Q menu.
[*]Players can now queue for Ranked games immediately after reaching level 10.
[*]The Inspection Kit now also outputs a text result on the items screen in addition to the coloured emblem to improve clarity.
[*]Changed naming of 'Local' to 'LAN (Offline)' to avoid confusion.
[*]Various improvements have been made to spectator mode.
[*]Certain assets will begin preloading for the upcoming Halloween Event.
[*]A Thai region has been added to the server list.
[/list]

notes.title: v4.0.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/7f3b5b031099b5d661b92541ec7c49a4253892c4.jpg[/img]

[b]Objective Changes:[/b]
[list][*]The first zone double objective now gives the Shotgun.
[*]The second zone double objective now gives the Inspection Kit.
[*]The first zone now predominately contains light items in the objectives.
[*]Levers now spawn closer to the objectives they activate.
[*]You now receive 3 Traps from objectives instead of just 1.
[/list]

[b]Night Period Changes:[/b]
[list][*]There are now 3 Fuse Boxes in the first zone and 2 in the second. You need to put 1 Fuse in each.
[*]If you fail to fill all the Fuse Boxes during the night period the game will go into enraged mode. If you still can't put all the Fuses in during this time the innocents will lose.
[*]When the enraged period starts the fuses can be viewed from further away.
[/list]

[b]Terror Changes:[/b]
[list][*]You can now drink blood during enraged periods.
[*]You can no longer interact with fuses whilst in Terror Form.
[*]Terrors now have 100 "light health". This value is affected by light items (i.e. the camera). This value affects the Terror's movement speed and, eventually, it's ability to execute innocents.
[*]Terrors can't execute when they've reached 30 light health. During this period they also can't transform.
[*]Light items no longer down terrors and the only way to down terrors is via gun damage.
[*]After 3 seconds of not taking light damage Terrors will start to regenerate their light health. It takes 1.5 seconds to fully regenerate your light health.
[*]Terrors now glow when they are hit by light items. This scales with their light health and becomes a lot more prominent when a Terror is unable to execute an innocent.
[*]Terror executions can now be cancelled with light items! The Terror must be put into the "unable to execute" state for this to occur.
[*]A blood particle effect has been added to Terror executions. When this happens you will no longer be able to cancel the execution.
[*]The cooldown for transforming has been increased to 6 seconds.
[*]There's now a warning before you're automatically transformed out of Terror Form.
[/list]

[b]Vent Changes:[/b]
[list][*]You can now choose the vent that you exit from.
[*]If you don't choose a vent within 10 seconds you will leave via the vent you entered.
[*]Once you've chosen a vent there is 3 second travel time and a noise will be triggered from the vent you are exiting.
[*]Lights have been added to the vents to make them more obvious.
[/list]

[b][New item] Torch:[/b]
[list][*]The Torch is our third light item in the game. When 'fire' is held down it produces a beam of light that will apply light damage to the Terrors.
[*]Deals 30 light damage a second.
[*]Has 20 seconds of battery life.
[/list]

[b]Character Select Changes:[/b]
[list][*]You no longer select a character during the initial period of the game but instead choose a preferred character on the Main Menu.
[*]All 6 players will play as a unique character in the game.
[*]If multiple people have the same preferred character the game will randomly choose the character they play as.
[*]New animations have been added to be shown in this period of the game.
[/list]

[b]End of Game Changes:[/b]
[list][*]This is now shown on the Main Menu instead of in-game.
[*]The way you give reputation to players after games has been improved.
[*]You can see the event time line of what happened during the game on this screen. If you leave the game early it will dynamically fill these in.
[*]A different environment is shown in the background based on the map you just played.
[*]As long as all of your party are in this screen you will remain together and be able to requeue once you've left the screen.
[*]The players you just played with are now shown in the 'Recent Players' section of the friends list. You can add them as friends, view their profile, invite them to your party or report them. Any friends you played with will not be shown in this list.
[/list]

[b]Perks:[/b]
[list][*]Our third Perk Tree has been added to the game along with new emblem rewards.
[*]There's now a unique background for the Perk Tree when viewing it.
[*]You are now refunded up to 5 rows worth of points after a season change. This is based on how many points you had received in the previous season. 
[*]New perks:
    [list][*]Blood Thirsty: Move 10% faster towards Innocents carrying fuses whilst in Terror Form.
    [*]Locked On: Your Terror sense highlights players with fuses that aren't running.
    [*]Stubborn: Levers that you've activated require more damage to be disabled.
    [*]Fun Sponge: You gain half a slice of Terror strength for each lever you deactivate.
    [*]Every Last Drop: If you respawn in human form you will only lose half a slice of Terror strength.
    [*]Weak Point: There's a 10% chance that a lever is instantly deactivated when you damage it.
    [*]Vengeance: After respawning in Terror Form you can see the person that downed you for 5 seconds.
    [*]Blasé: When downed, additional votes cast on you increase your respawn time by 4 seconds instead of 5.[/list]
[/list]

[b]Environment:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed some objects / lights popping in on the Arctic map.
[*]Updated the lighting on the Asylum map.
[*]Moved some consumable spawns that blocked other things in the map.
[*]Lever spawns have been adjusted so that the screens are more visible.
[*]The exits in the Arctic map now lead to somewhere...
[*]Fixed some holes in rocks in the Forest map.
[*]Going into the fountain on the Asylum map no longer makes your screen black.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed some objectives in the final section of the Arctic map not interacting properly with players.
[*]Fixed the Clean Ears perk not properly adjusting the audio.
[*]Fixed multiple Traps being used up if you had more than one in your inventory.
[*]Fixed occasionally not receiving any Traps from objectives.
[*]Reduced the intensity of the HUD loading in game in order to resolve some crashes.
[*]The Terror's arms will no longer wave around when blinded.
[*]Added more checks to the Loot Booth to stop it bugging out.
[*]Fixed being able to get rewards from the shoot objective after it was disabled.
[*]The Shotgun no longer clips with the double objective.
[*]Fixed a bug where an incorrect amount of objectives spawned.
[*]You can no longer transform when entering a vent.
[*]You can no longer jump when entering a vent.
[*]You can no longer place a trap while being executed.
[*]The "Out of Ammo" tip will now only show when your pistol is out of ammo.
[*]The Camera is now removed from your inventory when out of ammo.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could give multiple users reputation after a game.
[*]When slowed you can no longer jump to move faster.
[*]Fixed a bug where infected players would be shown in their innocent form after being downed as a Terror.[/list]

[b]Deceit Shop:[/b]
[list][*]With the change to free to play we are altering the store and the item pricing adding a new Token package and XP booster items.
[*]When you buy a token package you will also receive a number of GM credits.  
[*]Tokens & Credits:
    [list][*]$3.99 = 10 Tokens, 500 GM Credits
    [*]$7.99 = 20 + 5 Tokens, 1250 GM Credits
    [*]$14.99 = 40 + 15 Tokens, 2750 GM Credits
    [*]$29.99 = 80 + 30 Tokens, 5600 GM Credits[/list]
[*]XP Boosters:
[*]Boosters items when used will increase the XP gain for the time duration they are active.
    [list][*]$0.99 = 50% XP Boost for 1 Day
    [*]$1.99 = 50% XP Boost for 3 Days
    [*]$3.99 = 50% XP Boost for 7 Days[/list]
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list][*]Any player who has already purchased the game before it goes free to play will receive a selection of exclusive cosmetic items. Innocent T Shirt, Infected T Shirt, Terror Jawbone Melee weapon and the Mills PPQ pistol item.
[*]Added the Turkish language.
[*]To welcome new players to the game and allow them to experience a broader selection of perks more quickly, there will be a bonus XP weekend from the 13th - 15th.
[*]The locomotion animations have been improved.
[*]An animation has been added for escaping at the end of the game.
[*]Added a button to take you directly to Deceit's Twitch page.
[*]You can now authenticate your Twitch account in game. If you've purchased anything on Twitch this will put it on your account.
[*]A lot of UI elements have been vastly improved.
[*]The player's main objective at the top of the screen is now more precise and will show an additional message to the Infected.
[*]As an Infected player you will now be made more aware when you're enraged by a text display over your Terror strength bar.
[*]Timer in the top-right is now more obvious.
[*]As an Infected player you will now see your teammates name when being shown which team you're on.
[*]You'll now stay in the loading screen until everyone has connected. A tick will appear next to a player's name once they've connected.
[*]The numbering appended to player names has been removed due to having unique characters.
[*]The Camera has a slightly longer delay between shots and does reduced damage.
[*]Your language is now initially based off of your Steam language.
[*]The lever handle has been inverted so that it's easier to see the screen.
[*]Updated the web links on the Main Menu.
[*]Lever health is now shown on the screen of the lever.
[*]Health kits now regenerate 100 health over 5 seconds instead of instantly.
[*]New splash screens have been added for loading into the main menu.
[*]The loading screens when going into a game have been updated.
[*]You can now fire both barrels of the Shotgun a lot faster.
[*]It is now clearer whether or not you won on the final screen shown to you in-game.
[*]Added new tips for the torch and half blood bags.
[*]The current objective at the top of your screen will now fade out over time after your first few games.
[*]A light has been added to the spectator camera to make it easier to see in the night periods.
[*]The XP required to level up has been adjusted. Players from before the F2P update will keep their current level.
[*]The "We The Best" achievement has been changed to "Level up and prestige for the first time".
[*]Drop rates of items in the Loot Booth have been adjusted.
[*]The daily highscores no longer give a reward.
[*]You no longer get a free Loot Booth token per season.
[/list]

notes.title: Community Update – Free to Play
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

As I’m sure many of you have seen our studio recently expanded as we secured a large investment for an upcoming open world title which was announced via various news outlets late last month. For those of you that are out of the loop you can read more about that [url=https://improbable.io/company/news/2017/09/19/automaton-raises-10m-and-announces-groundbreaking-game-project-built-on-improbables-spatialos]here[/url]. We’re using that to show some love for our existing fans through greatly expanding the scope of our upcoming update to Deceit and making the game free to play. In addition to this, we’re offering anyone who already owns the game, or chooses to buy it prior to the update, a bunch of goodies so you can celebrate with us.

Starting October 13th Deceit will be completely free meaning all the users emailing us, tweeting at us and direct messaging us that they’d love to play with their friends and fans can link them to the store, wait for them to finish downloading it and hop in to a game. We believe Deceit is at it’s best when enjoyed as a fun party game and now to further bolster that, everyone is invited. 

For existing players and those that choose to pick up a copy prior to the update, we have a special pack of four exclusive cosmetic items, a 3 day experience booster and 10 loot booth tokens which we will be rolling out shortly – our way of saying thank you for all of the support shown to us throughout developing our studio’s first title. For those of you who like to unwrap your presents early, below is a shot of Hans and Nina showcasing a sneak peak of the exclusive gear: An ‘innocent’ shirt, an ‘infected’ shirt, a new look for the pistol and a terror jawbone melee weapon.

notes.title: Community Update – Incoming changes to light and darkness
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/4dbc5b389b2595cee1aed8776e4d03911eebd88c.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

As we’re headed toward the end of the season it’s a great time for a community update, starting with some upcoming changes to Deceit. Over the next few releases we’re going to be introducing a fresh perk tree, fixing up a few more hitches, and gradually phasing in some brand-new mechanics – topping it off with an additional item based on the Terror’s weakness to light. 

It’s worth mentioning as a sort of disclaimer **this is a preview and only partially indicative of final gameplay**, some of this stuff may change though we’re pretty confident in how it’s working out in internal play testing.

[h1]Blackout changes[/h1]
A prevailing thought in community feedback has been that the Terror doesn’t quite feel like the superhuman killing machine it was engineered to be. Our bogeyman may be at home in the dark but with defensive strategy from the opposing side it can be difficult to achieve much against the coordination and positioning innocent players often utilise. In the current version of Deceit, the blackout phase can be shortened by innocents collecting fuses, prematurely restarting the lights to force the Terrors back into their human form and ensure their own safety, but if they choose not to the lights just come back on anyway and their escape continues mostly unhindered. 

Our next patch aims to shake this up a bit, introducing part one of our light and darkness gameplay changes: Unending Darkness. During the blackout, innocents can collect fuses and the infected can use their strength to transform, executing players as they did before but with one major change; if the test subjects choose not to complete the sinister Game Master’s objective, the Terror’s will gain strength from their time in the darkness, powering up into an early enrage period. This enrage period only ends if the fuses are placed inside the fuse box, bringing the lights back on and continuing the game as normal.

The goals for this change are to not only sharpen up the game thematically but to increase the value of each item as innocents will find their use crucial for fighting towards their objective and surviving in the darkness

[h1]Light changes[/h1]
Alongside changes to the darkness in Deceit we’re going to be revamping the way that terrors interact with light; we’re removing the physical damage component caused by items such as the camera and trap and adding an entirely new stat: Light damage. Light damage will only affect terrors in terror form and works separately from their normal health, the more light damage inflicted on a terror the slower the terror will move, allowing innocents to make their escape. If a terror takes enough light damage they’ll be temporarily stunned and immune to receiving any further light damage until they’ve fully recovered so don’t stick around for long!

In line with the light changes we’re also tweaking the camera to have a clearer targeting reticule allowing users to see if the terror is in range and require a short charge up before use to reign in the so-called paparazzi plays.

[h1]Terror Luminescence[/h1]
Rounding out our list of new mechanics, light damage also has a secondary effect called Terror Luminescence, when a terror takes light damage they’ll also light up making it easier for innocent players to coordinate in an attempt to bring them down. Once they’re back in the dark (or if they’re shot until they respawn) the glow gradually fades until they’re back to their normal stealthy look.

[h1]New Item: Flashlight[/h1]
Marking the introduction of a horror movie classic, the flashlight will be a new source of light damage, projecting a cone of light which can be aimed at an incoming terror to help keep them at bay. In our current test build, as with the camera, it’s damage is based on range and increases the closer the terror is to the light source making for some hair raising escapes so long as it doesn’t run out of batteries…

[h1]Stay up to date![/h1]
Whether you’re itching to read the follow up post full of numbers and bullet points, can’t wait to see the latest videos from our staff talking about upcoming changes or want to share your favourite Deceit moments with us and the rest of our fans – be sure to stay up to date by following us on [url=https://twitter.com/PlayDeceit]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayDeceit/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/playdeceit]Twitch TV[/url] for all of the latest news. 

[b]Sam Hills[/b]
Community Manager

notes.title: v3.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Daily hiscore rewards have been added
[*]Top 10 will receive 3 loot booth tokens and 250 credits. Top 100 receives 1 loot booth token and 100 credits to spend in the store
[*]Added hit markers for traps
[*]Re-designed multiple in-game UI elements including waypoints and item icons
[*]Tweaks have been made to the lighting in multiple maps
[*]When entering a game the main menu UI now says "Game Found" instead of putting you into a game straight away
[/list]


[b]Perk Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]The 'Eye Spy' perk has been re-worked to now allowing you to see name tags at a close distance in the dark, instead of allowing you to see name tags from further away
[*]The 'Interrogate' perk was changed to "If you're involved in a vote that passed there is a chance that you will be told if they were Infected. Only one person can be informed per passing vote." This mean there is no longer a 100% chance of it working if no one else in the game owns the perk
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed lethal injection stats being incorrectly tracked
[*]Emblems that are no longer accessible aren't shown any more
[*]Terrors now regenerate health when out of combat
[*]Terrors can now kill multiple people during the enrage period as expected
[*]Terrors are no longer transformed back to human form after killing during the enrage period
[*]Terrors can now transform correctly after using the lethal injection
[*]Players no longer escape if they respawn after being downed on an exit that opens
[*]The Interrogate perk no longer has a 100% chance of working if no one else in the game owns the perk
[*]The prices of unlocks have been fixed to represent their true value
[*]Certain trees have had their colliders change to stop players from getting to unintended parts of the map
[*]Limited the values to which the brightness slider can be set to
[*]Added more checks to stop people from being unintentionally be put into games
[*]Fixed MVP/LVP Steam achievements
[*]Fixed the left arrow on the character select screen not showing
[/list]

notes.title: v3.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/b2a27abac36a1108ebe4e2c1eebea4025ebcaa46.jpg[/img]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Party members' models now join you on the main menu.
[*]You can now view the last character your friend played as when hovering over their name in the friends list.
[*]Introduced new perk system.
[/list]

[b]New Perk System[/b]
The legacy trait system has now been replaced with something we've called the Perk Tree! A selection of character buffs that will change each month, available from the main menu. As you earn XP in-game you will collect points that you can spend in the tree, creating a chain of perks that suits your playstyle. The system allows us to keep the game fresh by offering a variety of strategies month-on-month that players can use to aid in their trust and deception tactics. Reach the end of the tree before the end of the season to unlock a unique emblem for that tree. Go even further by unlocking all the perks in the tree to also receive an improved version of the emblem.

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*]The XP bar has been removed from the character select screen.
[*]Updated the lighting in the Asylum map.
[*]Tweaked our anti-cheat detection to stop falsely eliminating players at the beginning of the round.
[*]Loading screen messages have been re-added.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the shotgun would disappear and not allow players to change weapons.
[*]Killing a player in terror form while falling now causes the blood bar to reset correctly.
[*]Added potential fixes for players being left in a strange state after transforming.
[*]Fixed a UI bug on the end of round screen where the experience bar would overflow.
[*]NiNa now uses the correct trouser model on certain outfits to stop clipping issues with her belt.
[*]Players' prestige now shows correctly on the loading screen.
[*]The reward type prefix on the loot booth screen has been fixed for Terror cosmetics.
[*]Added blocking under Arctic stairs to prevent players respawning under them.
[*]Removed a box in Arctic to prevent players jumping on shelves.
[*]It is no longer possible to re-select the item you're currently equipping.
[*]Fixed multiple miscellaneous crashes that have been reported.
[*]Added more objects to be pre-cached whilst loading.
[*]Fixed an animation cancel when going through vents.
[*]Level and Prestige are now correctly displayed on the loading screen.
[*]Fixed aim poses for several items.
[/list]

notes.title: v3.00.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/cf1ce4bd422cd2011621791aae6ccc2ed40789e8.jpg[/img]

[b]Features[/b][list]
[*]Our 2 new characters, Hans and NiNa, have been added into the game!
[*]Werewolf Terror Skin! Has been added.
[*]Hungarian and Italian languages have been added.
[*]Progression Update
[*]Character levels have been consolidated into one level. All previous XP has been added together to give you your current amount.
[*]The amount of XP to level up starts at 1.5k and increases up to a flat amount of 10K.
[*]10 prestiges have been added to the game. Reaching lvl 100 will automatically prestige you. You lose nothing by prestiging.
[*]We've introduced a Casual and a Ranked queue. Casual queue allows playing with groups of any size but Ranked queue limits it to 2. You unlock Ranked by reaching level 10.
[*]Traits are now shared across all characters. You can now only select a normal T1, T2 and T3 trait along with a terror T1 and T2 trait.
[*]Trait challenges are now unlocked via Loot Booth tokens. If you have previously completed a challenge you will still have the trait. If you unlock a challenge you had previously progressed you will keep that progress.
[/list]

[b]Main Menu Update[/b][list]
[*]The background scene has been updated.
[*]An asset revamp! An initial pass has been made so far but more will be coming over the following month.
[*]The tutorial video link has been updated to the latest version.
[*]The build number is now shown in the bottom right, clicking on it will bring up the latest patch notes.
[*]Newly unlocked items are now marked in your cosmetics tab under Profile.
[*]The Profile button will appear golden if you have unseen cosmetics.
[*]The Loot Booth button will appear golden if you have tokens to spend.
[*]You no longer receive a notification when you get an item from the Loot Booth.
[/list]

[b]Chat & Friends Systems[/b][list]
[*]You can now add friends in Deceit (Steam friends will be automatically imported).
[*]See if your friends are in game, offline or ready to play!
[*]When friends with someone you can privately message them and view their profile.
[*]Party chat was added to the main menu to allow you to communicate while searching for games.
[/list]

[b]Player profiles[/b][list]
[*]Statistics - See how many times you've stolen an objective or how often your friend gets voted out!
[*]Daily XP Highscores - Earn Loot Booth tokens and GM Credits by reaching the top 10/100 for XP gained in a day!
[*]Seasonal Elo Highscores - Earn Bronze cosmetics for reaching the Elo system and Gold/Silver for hitting the top 10/100!
[*]Reputation Highscores - Compare your reputation with others. You can tip player profiles for 20 GM Credits in the Main Menu or for free at the end of a game.
[*]Traits - View your progression on unlocked traits.
[*]Notes - Examine notes found around the game.
[*]Cosmetics - Customise your characters.
[*]Match History - View your past 20 games played.
[*]Loot booth rewards are now shown in 3D to give you a better idea of the items collected.
[*]If you have traits to unlock you will get both a cosmetic and a trait challenge from cups in the loot booth. Selecting rarer cups will earn you higher tier challenges.
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b][list]
[*]Terrors now move faster but have less health, when they are downed they re-spawn. When they re-spawn they lose one blood bar segment. A full blood bar is need to transform into terror form but only one is required to perform an execution. So even if you are downed with full blood you still have a chance to execute.
[*]Infected players now have terror sense during the day period, letting them have a better idea of where innocent players are and making it easier to collect blood.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list]
[*]Fixed a number of environment bugs across all three maps.
[*]Knife skins have been fixed.
[*]Fixed players not receiving emblems for reaching Diamond.
[*]Fixed a bug in the loot booth where the cup selected didn't have the correct reward in it.
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous [/b][list]
[*]The vents in the Arctic map have been updated to the correct model.
[*]Optimisation across all 3 maps, Arctic, Forest and Asylum
[*]Added a skip button to the loot boot. Pressing it will give you a random reward.
[/list]

notes.title: July 5th - Update Preview
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/4ec0c0c8623e21840bb73996cc688b41bfd23c4a.jpg[/img]

[b]On July 5th, we’re releasing our biggest Deceit update yet, encompassing a whole new host of features which we’re further detailing today![/b]

[h1]Queue System Changes[/h1]
[list][*][b]Region Lock[/b]
Region locks will allow players to select strict limits on regions to play in and select language(s) that they feel comfortable communicating in, helping players to better understand each other in an average game of Deceit.
[*][b]Ranked and Casual queues[/b]
Casual play will allow players to level up, learn the ropes and play with parties of any size. Ranked will require the player to have reached level 10, ensuring they have a reasonable understanding of the game, and will be restricted to parties of two.[/list]

[h1]UI Overhaul[/h1]
[list][*][b]Player profiles[/b]
Like many popular multiplayer games, players will have their own profile allowing them to see their stats and performance in the game.
[*][b]Friends list[/b]
In preparation for allowing players to purchase the game through other platforms instead of Steam, the new user interface will feature a brand-new friends list. Players can add each other as friends by sharing a short code which is unique to them.
[*][b]Chat system[/b]
Players will be able to chat with their friends and party members outside of a match.
[*][b]Reputation system[/b]
Players will be able to commend other players after a game awarding them for a great performance, viewable through their profile. Additionally, players can use in game currency to reward people outside of a match.
[*][b]Match history[/b]
Inside of each player profile they will be able to view their match history, breaking down number games played and their results. 
[*][b]Patch notes visible in game[/b]
At the bottom of the UI the version number will be visible with a button which will expand patch notes making it easier for players who skip the Steam update news to understand changes to the game.[/list]

[h1]High score system[/h1]
We’re expanding our high score system to give players a variety of goals to aim for as they play Deceit.
[list][*][b]Daily experience leader board[/b]
Resetting every day, players can compete to collect the most experience by winning games, completing objectives and helping their teammates. Each day, the players who collect the most will receive a reward.
[*][b]Reputation leader board[/b]
To celebrate the players with the best reputation, we’re introducing a leader board for everyone to see. Acting as a natural shout out to the friendliest teammates, the most altruistic antidotes and fierce yet honourable opponents. 
[*][b]Season ELO leader board[/b]
Continuing the competitive trend, each season will maintain an ELO leader board allowing the diehard challengers to build on their rivalries as they continue to show who’s best at Deceit.[/list]

[h1]Win of the day[/h1]
Resetting every day, players will receive bonus experience for their first win allowing them to unlock their favourite cosmetics a little bit quicker.

[h1]Unified profile level[/h1]
[list][*][b]No more character levels![/b]
Users will now level their profile instead of levelling each character individually, as before each level will unlock coins for the loot booth.
[*][b]Ranked unlocked at level 10[/b]
New players will be defaulted to the casual queue to learn the ropes until reaching level 10 and unlocking ranked play.
[*][b]Prestige Levels[/b]
Profiles will be able to level up to 99 before automatically being prestiged allowing them to do it all over again unlocking unique rewards and more loot.[/list]
 
[h1]Unified traits system and trait re-balancing[/h1]
[b]Traits selected across characters[/b]
Traits will no longer be locked to characters allowing players to build around their favourite playstyle while playing the character they enjoy the most. We’re keeping a close eye on how this pans out and expecting to rebalance and adjust some traits accordingly.

[h1]Werewolf Terror form skin[/h1]
Introducing a brand-new style, the werewolf skin will come complete with unique sound effects, paying homage to the classic board game. 

[h1]New Characters[/h1]
[b]Two new unique and original characters[/b]
Also with the update we’ll be introducing two new and unique characters each with their own style and cosmetics. They will have their own separate reveal soon!

[h1]Stay up to date![/h1]
Until then, be sure to stay up to date by following us on Twitter, Facebook and Twitch TV for the latest news.

notes.notes:

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Your health no longer regenerates and instead there are Health Packs around the map. These will put you back at 100 health.
[*]10 more emblems have been added to the collection. These can be unlocked by achieving certain ranks, unlocking all the notes and completing all the trait challenges.
[*]Implemented a new System for streaming assets in the forest improving performance. 
[*]Added More props to the arctic, making it feel more fleshed out.
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]The knife now does 50 damage, down from 70.
[*]Terrors can no longer swipe whilst stunned by the camera.
[*]The amount of armour that spawns has been reduced by 1 per area.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where players legs would Tpose when jumping and inspecting with the inspection kit
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*]You can no longer select input devices as your output device
[*]You can now change your voice output device on the fly
[*]Added a new system in the Forest which will stop rendering of higher fidelity assets on "low" settings. sacrificing some visual quality for better performance. 
[*]"Low" settings should now have a big difference in Visuals and Performance
[*]The Bounce Back trait now gives you a minor health regen. The challenge is now completed by using Health Packs.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.8.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/1116fcd93490c055e4f8806ce5d1a08d76428f91.jpg[/img]
[b]Features[/b] 
[list]
[*] Arctic Map - Available from Wednesday 10th - due to issues found in beta testing
[*] Fuse System
[olist]
[*] Once a blackout has started the Game Master will activate a Fuse Box and deploy some Fuses around the map.
[*] If you fill the Fuse Box up with Fuses it will cause the blackout to end within 10s.
[*] You require 3/2/1 Fuses out of the 7/5/3 that spawn to complete the Fuse Box. This changes based on the zone you're in.
[*] Spawned Fuses will beep and be outlined when you're near them.
[*] The golden lever in the final zone has been replaced with this system.
[*] It is not required for the Fuse Box to be filled for the blackout to end but you do need to fill it to escape.
[/olist]
[*] Map Progression
[olist]
[*] Once a blackout has finished only one door will open to the next floor.
[*]  The day periods are now 90/75/60s, scaling based on zone.
[*] Night periods last 90s.
[/olist]
[*] Terror Changes
[olist]
[*] Terrors now require 3 full slices of blood to be in Terror Form.
[*] You can only execute players when you have 3 full slices of blood.
[*] After executing your blood drains over 10 seconds and you will be put back into human form if you haven't already transformed back.
[*] Each blood bag now gives 1 full slice of blood.
[*] Health has been increased by 25%.
[*] Terrors now move 10% faster than humans, down from 20%.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could drink blood at full strength.
[*] The Camera flash no longer completely blinds you unless you're close.
[*] Terror Sense now scans the area every 5s instead of 10s but only detects running players.
[/olist]
[*] A tips system has  been added to the game to help new users, this gives instructions on how to play the game as they play for the the first five matches. For the experienced players they can be toggled  off from the  game settings.
[*] Three new sets of diary entries have been added and can be collected on the new arctic map.
[*] The loot booth cups game now allows you to choose the cup you want to pick.
[*] Players now can re queue to join a new game while in spectator mode.
[*] The CCTV cameras used in spectator mode have been replaced with a 3rd person follow camera.
[*] Replaced the blurry bleeding out camera with a third person camera.
[*] Added French, Polish, and Portuguese translations
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] You now have 40 seconds of Oxygen up from 30 seconds.
[*] The 'Vibrant' trait now blinds terrors when they are downed.
[*] Reworked the 'Vibrant' and 'Come prepared' traits to work more reliably.
[*] To take into account the changes to the loot booth there has been a reworked the rates of rare loot cups appearing in the loot booth cups game.
[*]  Borrowed Time trait now reduces the time for the door to open by 1s per Fuse you put in the Fuse Box. You will have to complete the new challenge to use it again.
[*] Reserves trait  now has a chance to leave you with 1 slice instead of only using half the blood.
[*] Heightened Senses' trait challenge has doubled and makes Terror Sense update every 4s.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the wrong map was displayed at the start of the loading screen
[*] Fixed a bug with the loot cups animations causing them to flicker.
[*] Removed rock that was covering some spawn points.
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*] Player nametags now fade out the further away you are.
[*] You can no longer walk through the target shoot objective.
[*] Easter has come to an end and the easter reward system has been removed.
[*] New Loot Cups animations
[/list]
[*] Added French, Polish, and Portuguese translations
[/list]

notes.title: v2.7.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/9e2425e09af52d3dea2fd6e492794b2960c5f09d.jpg[/img]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Traps have been added as a new objective reward that can be deployed anywhere. If a Terror walks near one during the night it will trigger, downing them temporarily. It's also worth mentioning that the Infected can deactivate the trap so keep an eye out for suspicious behaviour.
[*]Added terror voice chat this is a channel only for infected players to help them better coordinate.
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased foliage size in the Forest to break sight lines and allow players to more efficiently hide.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Female iron sight animation transition issue fixed.
[*]The consumable placement in the Asylum has been updated to fix some issues with blood bag spawns.
[*]The collision box in staff room has been changed to fix issue where players were registered on the next floor without reaching the next floor.
[*]Fixed exploit in North Stairwell of the Asylum where the player could reach floor 3 before it was open.
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved animation blendspaces, this reduces the appearance of a character sliding when running and walking.
[*]Blood splats are now applied to the walls when the player is hit by bullets close to them.
[*]Armour now displays as a decaying icon in the nametag instead of a bar.
[*]The gun is now hidden during the tracker animation
[*]You can now select the output device for voice chat.
[*]Waypoints were updated, this should have a positive effect on performance.
[*]The crosshair should be hidden while running
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v2.3.0 - Main Menu Rework & Loot Booth
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/3a2f23113e7d95eef7ab34c98981159353be2b48.png[/img]
This week we have gotten rid of our boring placeholder menu background and replaced it with a new 3d-scene, which really improves the quality and initial look of the game when you first open it. Along side this we've scrapped our crates system, replacing it with a brand new 'Loot Booth'. Visit the game master, cross his palm with a coin, and play his game to see what sick loot you can win. Players skilled enough to make it onto our highscores will be rewarded with special Bronze/Silver/Gold tokens which can be used for the chance to win exclusive bronze/silver/gold loot only available with these coins.

[b]End of season[/b]

Now the season is ending, prizes will be handed out and we're prepping for the next season to begin! As we reset, the following will happen:
[list]
[*]When you log in next you will be displayed your final position for Season 1 and your rewards

notes.title: v2.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Skill-based matchmaking: Matchmaking will now attempt to band players of a similar rank together
[*]Added custom clothes for each character - you unlock the hat at level 3, melee weapon at level 5 and the clothes at level 7 for that character
[*]Added more gun skins representing each language the game is translated into (Spanish, German, Chinese, Russian, Korean, and Japanese)
[*]Added fall back proxy servers to allow more people to be able to connect to our servers
[*]Added more reasons to the UI for why the game ended (e.g. time running out, last innocent escaping, last innocent killed)
[*]Added Japanese and Korean translations
[*]Improved Chinese translations
[*]Added Shadows menu option
[*]Removed SVOTI menu option
[*]Only show traits on the end of round screen that were not already completed
[/list]

[b]New Terror Traits[/b]

Tier 1:
[list]
[*]Every Last Drop: If you re-spawn you will keep a maximum of 1 slice of Terror strength
[*]Heightened Senses: Terror sense highlights Innocents every 8 seconds instead of 10
[*]Fun Sponge: You gain half a slice of Terror strength from each unique lever you deactivate
[/list]
Tier 2:
[list]
[*]Blood Thirsty: Move 10% faster when moving towards Innocents that are downed while in Terror Form
[*]Reserves: There is a 25% chance that you will only lose half a slice of [*]Terror strength when executing
[*]Sixth Sense: When in Terror Form all accessible blood bags are highlighted to you
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]The Camera now does half damage from behind a Terror
[*]The Camera now has a 1.5s delay between shots (up from 1.2s), it also has a new UI feature to indicate when you can use it again
[*]Modified the ELO formula so players should never gain 0 ELO
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Applied an engine fix to potentially stop a lot of crashes players experience
[*]Generally improved lighting and efficiency of maps to help improve FPS
[*]Changed lighting style used on Objectives to improve FPS
[*]Players are no longer popped to join a game if they no longer can connect to it (reducing the number of '5 man' games)
[*]Infected players can now move if the lights came on whilst they were downed in Terror Form
[*]You can now use the in game chat during character select, the end of round screen and while downed
[*]Fixed a bug causing the Cameraman trait not to work the first time you selected it
[*]XP gains now visually display for level 7 characters
[*]Improved the alignment of the animations on the escape hatch
[*]Tweaked our custom anti-cheat to give more accurate reports
[*]Increase time for scanning w/ inspection kit to stop people from getting infinite use from it
[*]Challenges no longer progress if you do not have the level to do so
[*]The tracker outline is now working on the Terror Form
[*]Fixed a pressure pad on the forest map that wasn't triggering correctly
[/list]

notes.title: v2.1.0 - Happy St Patrick’s Day!
notes.notes:
Hello! This has been a very busy week at the Automaton Studios, and we'd like to take a moment to thank everyone for the serious amount of support and growth we've seen in our community this week! This is the third (and likely last) patch we're putting out this week, and we're settled in our new office so we are fully prepared to bring you guys more updates in the future.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Happy St Patrick's Day! We have added in some limited time (1 week!) unique rewards obtainable from crates
[*]Players now die to the oxygen when the oxygen bar hits zero. When downed in the gas, the oxygen bar stops decreasing, and players then have to wait and will revive in the same spot
[*]Added in detection for players trying to cheat the game, and eliminates them instantly if theyre detected
[*]Added in prevention measures to stop players from trying to modify aspects of the game
[*]Improved a lot of our Chinese and Russian localization
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]More actions now have XP rewards tied to them (e.g. taking a blood bag, assisting with objectives, using items)
[*]Players can now be antidoted after being lethal injected (Note: we're still experimenting with this item)
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]The FPS on the main menu has been given a limit to minimize CPU usage
[*]Slightly re-wrote the way moving into the next zone works in order to fix the bug where players were dying to the gas in the next zone
[*]Fixed a crash related to shooting generators in the map with a shotgun
[*]Fixed some server-side CPU issues to allow the server to run more efficiently
[/list]
[b]Main Menu[/b]
[list]
[*]Main menu buttons have been moved from the right side to the left to make them easier to read
[*]Card buttons on the 'Play', 'Profile', and 'Test Subject' interfaces have been centralised and visually improved
[*]The diary entries interface now displays the notes in 3D rather than as a list
[*]Traits for each character are now split between tier so you can see easily which ones you have unlocked
[*]There is now a trait description interface to explain how different trait slots work
[*]Changing your character cosmetics now requires less clicking
[/list]

notes.title: v2.0.3 - More bug fixes, balancing, and optimization
notes.notes:
Before we move onto major content additions to Deceit, we wanted to clean up some of the code and fix a lot of the issues discovered from our new week 1 users, we hope this patch will improve FPS for some people, as well as reduce the number of crashes people are having!

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]The camera slow and blind effects are halved if the terror isn't facing you
[*]Terrors now have 1 second of immunity after being downed
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]The main menu now features a high scores which shows the ELO of all of the top players
[*]Dead players are shown to terrors on the Q menu
[*]Matchmaking will now prioritize grouping users with the same language settings
[*]Chinese letters have been added to our font
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues preventing us from using CryEngine's optimizations
[*]Potentially fixed the most common crash players are experiencing
[*]Fixed inspection kit being used on the wrong person
[*]Fixed a method of 'speed hacking'
[*]Fixed a bug where users could pause the game for everyone
[*]Fixed being unable to talk while Q was pressed
[*]Fixed a visual issue where related graphics settings weren't changed on the main menu's option screen after changing graphics quality
[*]Fixed a visual issue where your graphics setting differed between in game and the main menu
[*]Fixed traits being shown in the wrong slots
[*]Fixed the ranks and high scores of people in your party showing incorrectly on the main menu
[*]Reasons for your death are now shown when you die
[*]Glow sticks no longer flicker during the gas period
[*]You can now use the escape menu during character select
[*]Fixed a bug where you could move during the end of round screen
[/list]
[b]Environment[/b]
[list]
[*]General optimization in the forest map
[*]Made it clearer for the player to not go back into the previous zone in the forest
[*]Forest Lighting tweaks
[*]Fixed the forest floor terrain material
[*]Fixed a couple of areas in the forest map where you can get stuck
[*]Fixed falling out of the map on the ground floor of the asylum and an area in the second floor kitchen where collision acts odd
[*]Fixed some doors rotating the wrong direction
[*]Added point lights to the escape hatches in the forest
[*]Fixed red ball particle
[*]Moved character select screen in the forest
[/list]

notes.title: v2.0.2 Patch Notes - Bug fixes and Balancing
notes.notes:
Today we're releasing a bunch of bug fixes and gameplay balances. We have a whole load of optimizations in the works for our next release which we're aiming to get out on Friday, which should drastically improve the fps for everyone.

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]The Terror stealth perk is now a 30% noise reduction down from 80%
[*]Downing terrors now lasts for 3 seconds up from 2
[*]The tracker now lasts for 40 seconds down from 60
[/list]
[list]
[*]Shotgun:
[list]
[*]Speed has been slightly increased
[*]Number of pellets has been doubled
[*]Damage per pellet reduced by a third
[*]Spread reduced by 25%
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Camera:
[list]
[*]Camera effectiveness now scales linearly (between 5 and 20 meters).
[*]Damage against terrors - Current: 40%. New: Scales between 12.5% and 50%.
[*]Blind - Current: 100%. New: Scales between 25% and 100%.
[*]Slow - Current: 80%. New: Scales between 20% and 80.
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Alex traits:
[list]
[*]Reworked 'Say Cheese' - Camera instead gives an extra flash, in addition to 10% increased effectiveness against Terrors
[*]'Cameraman' trait now starts with a camera with half charges
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Players now walk into the escape door/hatch instead of interacting with them.
[*]The night time sonar ripple now appears on the UI
[*]The vSync setting has been added to the options
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the incorrect number of blood bags were spawning
[*]Fixed skinning issues where character's arms sometimes appear through their clothes
[*]Re-enabled the 'shirtless' Chang clothes after fixing a bug where some of his body would appear invisible
[*]The voice volume option now actually works
[/list]

[b]Environment[/b]
[list]
[*]Further improvements to lighting optimizations
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed missing character/terror sounds in blackwood forest
[*]Fixed missing escape hatch sounds
[*]Added UI sounds at round end screen
[*]Fixed missing armour pickup sound
[*]Fixed missing Game Master note pickup sound
[/list]

notes.title: v2.0 Patch Notes - FULL RELEASE!
notes.notes:

We're not done though, we still plan to update weekly and provide you guys with more content to dig your terror mandibles into! Below is a list of the patch notes for this week's update, but if you've not played in a while be sure to check out our patch notes and YouTube tutorial series as a lot has changed.

Also, check out our fancy new trailer! (linked at the bottom)

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Map![/b] Today we release our second map 'The Forest' for you to deceive and trick your friends and enemies on!
[*][b]Traits[/b] Leveling up your character now unlocks challenges that you can complete to unlock traits that give you a slight edge on others in the game! Level up all characters to 7 to unlock all of their traits and challenges.
[*][b]ELO System![/b] Reached rank 0? We have now implemented an ELO system which tracks how well you're playing relative to everyone else you're playing with.
[*][b]GameMaster Notes![/b] have been added to the game! Notes are outlined in purple and only 1 of each diary is spawned on each floor each game. Collect all the entries to answer questions about The Asylum, The GameMaster, and his secrets!

[*]The concept of run energy has been removed.
[*]Added a notification system to the main menu to inform you of level ups/game updates etc.
[*]The character XP formula for the amount of XP required per level has been increased.
[*]The in-game tutorial has been replaced by a link to our YouTube video series.
[*]Players can now pickup armour when they already have (non-full) armour.
Winning a game now only awards 1 mark not 2. When de-ranking you are now given half the marks of the previous rank. (Higher number if odd number).

[*]Fixed multiple crashes whilst closing the game.

[*]Fixed some level streaming issues

[*]Finalized the cell block room which is a large new room allowing for easier movement around the second floor, and adding 2 new ways up to the third floor.
[*]Added more spectator points to the asylum

notes.title: 24th Feb – Game Update, Release Schedule & Play Sessions
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This week we've released a version of the new Deceit, which incorporates the core gameplay changes that we've developed through our early access testing (including a further update today with more areas of the Asylum now available!). We have been very happy with how the majority of the changes have turned out and now have the gameplay in a great spot for our full launch. However, we are aware that the metagame (character levelling and interfaces), general user interface, tutorial content, website and community involvement are not up-to-scratch for the switch to transition to a non-early-access launch on Steam. Naturally, there's also a load of polish we'd continue to like to work on (animations, graphics, interfaces) as we continue to update Deceit. We will now continue to push weekly or bi-weekly updates as we work on these.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/d1e2d10368ed0af4375e2c8ed1c74a13ba2db204.png[/img]

It's most important to us that we take a few more days to polish each of these aspects so that we can grow the game most effectively when it is featured by Steam and other platforms on launch. We will be dramatically increasing our community management and marketing efforts over the coming days, so it can be clearer to you what to expect from our weekly updates from here on out, and it is clearer to new players how to get involved.

We're sorry for the delay pushing the button to bring in more users, but we have already begun scheduling in content creators for next week, and we are confident that we can build up the community with increasing effectiveness as the game progresses. We won't give an exact date for when the launch will be until we are 100% confident that we have everything in-place for launch, but we can say that we have done the vast majority of the work over the last month, and if you have any questions, please get in contact on Discord! We'll also be updating our website and Steam community with a lot more content over the next couple weeks as part of our investment community and marketing.

Thank you to everyone who's supported us and given us feedback during the early phases of Deceit, it's been a very ambitious project with a very unique idea and totally new engine platform, so we've come a long way in less than a year, and we intend to take the game much further over the next few weeks.

Finally, we will be announcing dev play sessions multiple times a week starting next week, at various times of day, so stay tuned for our Twitter or Discord announcements for more of these, and for upcoming streams & videos!

notes.title: V2.0a Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello! Have you missed us? Since our last patch 6 weeks ago we've been hard at work overhauling the entire game mode and re-working almost every core system in the game. We're releasing this preview of our major changes to Deceit in order to give our early access players a sneak peak of our full game release, and to gather any feedback for tweaks we can make.

[b]Objectives[/b]
[list]
[*]There are now levers scattered across each floor that are required to activate the objectives on that floor
[*]Pulling a lever gives you a waypoint to the appropriate objective
[*]Keep an eye out for the Infected as they can deactivate levers before the objective has been started
[*]Objectives that require two people to complete do not have levers associated with them
[*]Completing objectives now gives you the reward but also increases the length of the day period, and reduces the length of the dark period
[*]A new objective type has been added which requires you to damage three targets (knifing works as well as shooting)
[/list]

[b]Consumables[/b]
[list]
[*]You can find ammo scattered on the floor around the map
[*]You can find armour on the floor around the map
[*]Keep an eye out for Infected as they can now find blood bags on drip stands around the map to gain strength (no longer objective rewards)
[/list]

[b]Respawning[/b]
[list]
[*]Whilst downed other players can deal damage to vote on your elimination
[*]After being downed you will now respawn somewhere else on your current floor after an amount of time
[*]Your down time will increase for 5 seconds per vote cast on you so other players have time to vote on you
[*]The votes cast on you reset when you get back up
[*]The amount of votes required to eliminate someone becomes less per floor
[*]Players other than the person that downed you can interact you to revive you on the spot
[/list]

[b]Escaping[/b]
[list]
[*]At the end of each blackout there will be routes waypointed to get to the next floor that will open automatically, you no longer need to get a key
[*]If you don't progress through the map fast enough after the lights come back on a toxic gas will start to kill you (which also affects the Infected now)
[*]On the top floor there will be an escape lever (gold outline) that when pulled causes the lights to go out indefinitely and giving the Infected full strength
[*]The escape lever can only be pulled when the other objective levers are activate, the Infected cannot deactive this lever
[*]Once the escape lever is active you should head towards the waypointed escape door and interact with it which after a few seconds will open so you can escape
[/list]

[b]Win Condition[/b]
[list]
[*]Players no longer win as a team, scoring is based on individual play:
[*]An Innocent can win by escaping
[*]An Infected can win if nobody escapes
[/list]

[b]Ranking System[/b]
[list]
[*]From completing games you will now gain marks towards ranks:
[*]If you win you will gain 2 marks
[*]Innocent get an additional 1 bonus mark if someone escapes with them
[*]Infected get an additional 1 bonus mark if the other Infected survives with them
[*]If you lose you will lose 1 mark
[*]There are different bands of ranks:
[*]Bronze (ranks 20-16) requires 2 marks to rank up
[*]Silver (ranks 15-11 requires 3 marks to rank up
[*]Gold (ranks 10-6) requires 4 marks to rank up
[*]Platinum (ranks 5-1) requires 5 marks to rank up
[*]Diamond (rank 0) we will be adding an ELO system for players at this rank to compete on the highscores
[*]If you lose a mark at zero marks within a rank you will derank with 1 mark at that rank, though you cannot derank out of a band
[*]At the end of each month your rank will reset and you will be given a head-start towards the next months ranking
[/list]

[b]Character Leveling[/b]
[list]
[*]You will gain XP from doing various things during a game
[*]XP is character specific and allows you to level characters up to level 7, unlocking rewards at each
[*]You can continue to gain XP when you're at level 7 and work towards further crates being given
[*]The main benefit from leveling characters is that each level gives access to new trait slots, though it is worth mentioning that traits are currently disabled
[/list]

[b]Environment[/b]
[list]
[*]Lots of general polish to the asylum (graffiti, debris, general cleanup etc)
[*]Added an elevator shaft to one of the staircases
[*]Added new route up to the top floor through one of the staircases
[*]Added new 'Lift Lobby' room that connects the new route up from the middle floor to the canteen
[*]New lighting pass that drastically improves general FPS in the asylum
[/list]

[b]Animation[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where items weren't showing in characters hands on the main menu
[*]Fixed animation ragdoll issue when downed in third person
[*]Fixed skinning issues to Change, Rachel, Lisa, and their clothing
[*]Added 'into' and 'out of' transition blends to iron sights
[*]Fixes to third person pistol, camera and shotgun locomotion blending
[*]Fixes to the first person shotgun animations, keeping hands attached to the weapon
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*]Upgraded to the newest version of CryEngine (version 5.3.2)
[*]Added 22 new victory/defeat poses to the loot crates
[*]Reworked almost every UI element (both in game and on menu)
[*]Removed the concept of "crippling" after being downed
[*]Players names and ranks now display on the loading screen
[*]Moved a lot of player spawns
[*]Moved and added new CCTV cameras
[*]Players now spawn with just 6 bullets
[*]Added a grain effect to the CCTV cameras
[*]Added voice and length of down periods to name tags-
[*]Added indication for how long you're tracked for
[*]If you reach 0 run energy whilst holding shift it will no longer stutter
[*]You can no longer see your own name tag
[*]Fixed a bug where stamina wouldn't regenerate at the same rate after reviving
[*]Name tags are now hidden when you're downed
[/list]

notes.title: Full Game Launch and Planned Changes
notes.notes:
Hello!

Now 2017 is in full swing, we're excited to announce our full launch on 24th February. We have big plans for Deceit between now and then as we are planning to do our last big early access changes before our release. To wet your appetite, here are some of the things we have planned (subject to change):

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

To keep the gameplay fresh and replayable we're giving you more things to do in the day time, more reasons to doubt each other, and more ways to get around the map. Here are a few of the changes we're planning:
[list]
[*]Completing objectives now increases the length of the day period and reduces the length of the night period.
[*]Each objective is activated by pulling a lever somewhere on the map. If an objective is active and not started yet, the lever can be pulled to make it inactive.
[*]Doors now automatically open to the next floor after a blackout, and there is no longer a key.
[*]Ammo points are being removed, and instead there will be consumables placed around the map that are 'used' as soon as you pick them up (blood bags, ammo, armour, energy etc).
[*]Terrors will now be able to utilise the vents on the map to teleport around the map, in order to keep up their sneakiness.
[*]Players are now eliminated through the game by voting. Downing a player triggers a vote, and then other players can shoot their downed body to also vote for that player. Once enough votes have been cast, the player is then eliminated from the game.
[*]Once downed, players can now be revived by other players. If they aren't, they will re-spawn in a location on that floor. (Terror executions still eliminate)
[/list]

[b]Seasonal Ranking System[/b]

Players will now rank up and compete on a monthly seasonal basis to determine who is the best Deceit player in the world! The ladder will reset each month and you will start at the beginning of the ladder at rank 20. Each game you play you will gain 2 marks for a win, and lose one mark if you lose. Each rank will require a certain number of marks to rank up, and once you hit a certain rank you can not drop below that rank band until the ladder resets. Once a player reaches the top of the ranking system, they are then added to our leaderboard which will determine who the best deceivers are based on an ELO system, similar to how chess works. The top deceivers each month will then win prizes based on how well they have performed that month! (Note: winning will now be on an individual basis, so those clutch 1 man innocent escapes will still rank you up!)

[b]Character Leveling[/b]

We are replacing the current leveling and prestiging systems with a system that allows you to level on a per-character basis, and your trait slots will be tied to the level of your character. Don't worry! All progress currently made in the game will be transferable to the characters, so none of your time you've spent in the asylum will have been wasted.

[b]Forest Map (Name TBD)[/b]

Our second outdoor map is being released alongside our full launch. It is a night time outdoor map, which really lets the terrors run havoc: jumping over rocks, hiding behind trees, and sneaking up on people from any direction. Below is a sneak preview of what to expect:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/281a8e1eb67f324cb1027d2820b80466ae2fecbe.png[/img]

notes.title: Full Game Launch and Planned Changes
notes.notes:
Hello!

Now 2017 is in full swing, we're excited to announce our full launch on 24th February. We have big plans for Deceit between now and then as we are planning to do our last big early access changes before our release. To wet your appetite, here are some of the things we have planned (subject to change):

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

To keep the gameplay fresh and replayable we're giving you more things to do in the day time, more reasons to doubt each other, and more ways to get around the map. Here are a few of the changes we're planning:
[list]
[*]Completing objectives now increases the length of the day period and reduces the length of the night period.
[*]Each objective is activated by pulling a lever somewhere on the map. If an objective is active and not started yet, the lever can be pulled to make it inactive.
[*]Doors now automatically open to the next floor after a blackout, and there is no longer a key.
[*]Ammo points are being removed, and instead there will be consumables placed around the map that are 'used' as soon as you pick them up (blood bags, ammo, armour, energy etc).
[*]Terrors will now be able to utilise the vents on the map to teleport around the map, in order to keep up their sneakiness.
[*]Players are now eliminated through the game by voting. Downing a player triggers a vote, and then other players can shoot their downed body to also vote for that player. Once enough votes have been cast, the player is then eliminated from the game.
[*]Once downed, players can now be revived by other players. If they aren't, they will re-spawn in a location on that floor. (Terror executions still eliminate)
[/list]

[b]Seasonal Ranking System[/b]

Players will now rank up and compete on a monthly seasonal basis to determine who is the best Deceit player in the world! The ladder will reset each month and you will start at the beginning of the ladder at rank 20. Each game you play you will gain 2 marks for a win, and lose one mark if you lose. Each rank will require a certain number of marks to rank up, and once you hit a certain rank you can not drop below that rank band until the ladder resets. Once a player reaches the top of the ranking system, they are then added to our leaderboard which will determine who the best deceivers are based on an ELO system, similar to how chess works. The top deceivers each month will then win prizes based on how well they have performed that month! (Note: winning will now be on an individual basis, so those clutch 1 man innocent escapes will still rank you up!)

[b]Character Leveling[/b]

We are replacing the current leveling and prestiging systems with a system that allows you to level on a per-character basis, and your trait slots will be tied to the level of your character. Don't worry! All progress currently made in the game will be transferable to the characters, so none of your time you've spent in the asylum will have been wasted.

[b]Forest Map (Name TBD)[/b]

Our second outdoor map is being released alongside our full launch. It is a night time outdoor map, which really lets the terrors run havoc: jumping over rocks, hiding behind trees, and sneaking up on people from any direction. Below is a sneak preview of what to expect:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/281a8e1eb67f324cb1027d2820b80466ae2fecbe.png[/img]

These are a few of the core changes that we're making between now and the full release, alongside other useful technical tasks such as upgrading to the newest version of CryEngine 5, generally polishing the game, and adding new ways to find out answers to all of your burning questions about the game's lore. Thank you to everyone who has been playing Deceit since we launched in EA and have seen how far it has come in such a short period. We're really interested to hear your feedback on these changes, so please leave a comment or come and chat in our Discord to let us know what you think.

The Automaton Team
