notes.title: v1.8 Patch Notes - Merry Christmas!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/64b7a1247144954c622ec2cd64f1eea3fc870381.jpg[/img]

This [b]Deceit[/b] patch is packed full of new game play mechanics, game features, a new character, a new weapon, terror unlocks, Christmas decorations all around the asylum, and a whole bunch of fixes! Check below for the patch notes, and jump into game and get your Christmas Spook on!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Only a fixed number of objectives are now required to activate the key
[*]Terrors can now be downed when shot and flashed at
[*]The shotgun - a new objective reward - has been added into the game. This replaces your pistol for a limited time and packs one hell of a punch to both humans and terrors
[*]Another objective point has been added to the middle floor (can spawn as both the 2 person key objective as well as a regular objective)
[*]Strength is no longer used up over time. Simply one third (a slice) of the bar is required per execution
[*]The infected lose a slice of their bar when downed in terror form, or two slices when downed in human form
[*]The terror bar is now filled based on innocents getting downed (half a slice no matter who downed the innocent, or a whole slice if you downed them personally)
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Rachel has been added to the game
[*]Support for terror unlocks has been added.
[*]Users who have hit level 30 now have the clown terror unlock. This unlock will now be a rare unlock available from crates
[*]Integrated steam achievements
[*]Added character specific challenges to the game which are rewarded with character traits on completion
[*]Added 3 traits per character which slightly boost different aspects of the characters whilst playing them
[*]Lots of Christmas rewards have been added to the crates that are available for a limited time only
[*]You now only select the character you play at the beginning of a round
[*]Partial support has been added for prestiging when a user hits level 99
[/list]

[b]Main Menu[/b]
[list]
[*]Lots of UI elements as well as the general look and feel has been re-worked
[*]Character loadouts have been added to the menu, including new options for terror loadouts
[*]Tutorial slides have been added to the menu
[*]The trait configuration and challenge systems have been added to the menu
[/list]

[b]Environment[/b]
[list]
[*]Additional lighting tweaks through the map
[*]Added flickering TVs and TV effects
[*]Added Christmas decorations
[*]Added snow to the Atrium
[*]Fixed some issues with disappearing objects
[/list]

[b]Animation[/b]
[list]
[*]Added animations for Rachel
[*]Added animations for the shotgun
[*]'Into smoothing' animations have been added to movement and sprinting with the pistol
[*]The inspection kit has now been given a model and animations when used
[*]Fixed issues with knifing
[*]Fixed issues with aim poses
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Added sound to indicate the proximity of the closest terror
[*]Added more environmental sounds
[*]Added shotgun sound effects
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed multiple crashes
[*]Fixed more cases where players were T-Posing in the end of round screen
[*]Fixed a bug where it wasn't possible to take the key
[*]Fixed a bug where you were in the downed animation state after being revived
[*]The tracker waypoint has been moved off the floor, and now is hidden when in sight
[*]Fixed a bug where the inspection kit could be used multiple times
[*]The player's view is no longer vertically restricted when sprinting
[*]End of Round screen now functions correctly in LAN mode
[/list]

Version 1.7 of [b]Deceit[/b] is now live! Lots of changes, improvements, map additions, and bug fixes abound with this week's update! Be sure to hop into game and let us know what you think!

[b]Features[/b]
[list]

[*]The time that an antidote can be used after execution has been increased from 12 to 15 seconds
[*]Tracked people are now outlined as well as waypointed

[*]Fixed issue where you couldn't see certain models in certain rooms
[*]Fixed issues with the new inventory system not working as intended
[/list]

[b]Animation[/b]
[list]
[*]Added down and revive animations to all characters, both forwards and backwards
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]More audio feedback has been added for other players taking damage
[*]Added sound effects for tracking device, poison gas, and CCTV mode
[/list]

[b]Environment[/b]
[list]
[*]The storage exit room has been removed, and a new kitchen room has been added to replace it
[*]General polish to the atrium on both the ground and middle floor

[*]Bathroom on ground floor has been polished
[/list]

notes.title: Gameplay Updates Coming Friday 14th!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Having looked at a number of game sessions from our awesome community of early-early access players, we've been able to nail down the first big set of changes we want to make in order to balance the game, and ensure it has the suspense and tactics it deserves. Here is what we're currently planning for Friday's update (some may be introduced before that, we want to get this stable ASAP so we make a big noise about the game!):

•    Update to CCTV death cams (works in all cases, follows targeted players, make the UI clearer)
•    Exit game early button when you've been eliminated (you will see what XP you receive at this stage)

•    Camera Buff: Slow/root for longer
•    Knife Buff: 3 shot rather than 4, and reduce time between swipes
•    Look into lethal injection distance (it's currently too big)
•    Down time reduction to 8 seconds , still +5 for objective downs

•    Voice chat in game

•    Open up swimming pool area on the ground floor
•    Split up spawns: everyone will now spawn separately
 o    Objectives not active during 30 second setup period
•    Armour Changes
 o    Doesn’t regen
 o    Terrors must slash away at armour before executing

•    Third slot item (e.g. inspection kit, lethal injection) displayed on nametag
•    Ability to steal from downed people by pressing ‘E’
 o    Steals key first, third slot item second
 o    Can't steal some items (e.g. camera, armour)

•    The Antidote (NEW item)
 o    Stop throwing Innocent backwards during Terror execution animation
 o    When killed there needs to be a 8 second period where you can have an antidote used on you
•    Tracking Device (NEW item)
 o    See a blinking light of their location that speeds up when they’re closer

•    Key on top floor
 o    Unlocks a selected exit door, similar to other floors
 o    Can be used early (before last 30 seconds) but starts enrage period
 o    If exit door isn’t unlocked before last 30 seconds it automatically starts unlocking

On top of this we're continuing work to make sure it's easier to get in and out of games (such as fixing issues with the party system). We really look forward to our update on Friday, and hope you'll join us for it! :)

notes.title: Post-launch fixes & what's coming this week!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Now that we've fixed the unexpected issues from launch day, we know there's still a lot to do this week in two areas -- making joining and leaving games smoother, and making communication better.

Thanks for joining us so early, and we really look forward to the improvements we'll be bringing for the Halloween update. We appreciate that the game feels early in development, but we're confident that we can do a lot to improve this now that we've broken through the hurdle of getting the base out.

JOINING/LEAVING GAMES

Over the next couple of days we'll be pushing a number of fixes to make sure the following are addressed:

 - Party system has some issues meaning you need to restart your client in many cases to join a party successfully.
 - When a game ends, you can sometimes end up stuck in-game and need to alt-f4.
 - Death cameras don't work so you are stuck at black screen if executed, we will be fixing these.
- If you have to leave a game because a player didn't join, you are sent back to the click-to-continue screen instead of being re-queued straight away.

By the end of the week, you will also be able to begin queuing for another game whilst at the death screen. :)

COMMUNICATION

We will be introducing in-game voice chat, and some UI tweaks to make it clearer to a new player what certain things in-game do.

ADJUSTMENTS TO GAMEPLAY

We'll be increasing the effect of bullets against terrors, and making some tweaks to certain objectives so that they are even more useful to innocents in the dark.

We're also making the top floor more useful, so games don't fall short, and reducing the ability for terrors to multiple execute innocents too early in the game.

We'll post updates on our community forums as these are rolled out. We hope you'll at least check back at the end of next week when we're all the way through our first week of updates! :)

Thanks again for supporting us right at the beginning of early access, whilst the game still has a lot of room for improvement. We hope you enjoy what we're going to do with it over the coming months.

notes.title: Public Release 7th October & Further Testing Today
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We're really excited for our public launch into early-access. However, it's extremely important to us that the game is stable, and all of its core components are working before we allow anyone to buy it. Due to a few issues we've found during compatibility testing, we've unfortunately had to make the decision restrict our launch to a larger number of testers today, rather than the whole of Steam.

This will also allow us to begin the localization of the game into other languages, and work with international streamers on launch to promote the game.

On the up-side, we're happy that the game is performing well overall, being the first game to be built for release on the new CryEngine V platform, and operating on our new matchmaking network. We're confident Friday at 3PM GMT is a strong time to launch. We'll also be beginning our marketing campaign for the game tomorrow, allowing us to reach a larger community for launch.

Thanks very much for your understanding, and we really look forward to working with the early access community as soon as we can!

Regards,
The Automaton Team
